cards.en:
Spreadsheet software is an application that facilitates the processing of data. It helps with complicated calculations, visualisation of data using graphs and charts and processing tabular data, so data can be processed in a simpler way with less human effort.
In the past people used paper ledgers: data were handwritten and results recalculated by hand. In an electronic spreadsheet, calculations are carried out automatically and charts can be drawn in no time.
Key features to memorise:
  • formulae and pre-defined functions
  • sorting and filtering
  • conditional formatting
  • graphs and charts
Examples: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice Calc. Spreadsheet skills are useful in many careers that are not ICT-related: accountants and financial analysts (financial statements), project managers/administrative assistants (schedules), data journalists (organising data).
cards.zh:
试算表软件 (spreadsheet software) 是方便处理数据的应用程序：可以做复杂计算、用图表 (graphs and charts) 把数据可视化、处理表格数据 (tabular data)，从而简化处理、减少人手。
以前用纸本账簿 (ledger)，要手写数据、自己重算；电子试算表会自动计算，又能即时绘制图表。
要记的四个功能：公式和预设函数、排序和筛选、条件格式化、图表。
例子：Microsoft Excel、Google Sheets、LibreOffice Calc。会计、项目经理、数据记者等非 ICT 职业都需要试算表技能。

ex.q: A tuck shop records daily sales on paper and recalculates totals by hand. State TWO advantages of using spreadsheet software instead.
ex.a:
1. Formulae/functions recalculate automatically when data change, so fewer calculation errors and less human effort.
2. Data can be sorted/filtered and shown in charts quickly for analysis.
ex.az: 自动重算，减少错误和人手；可排序筛选及即时出图表。

cards.en:
Main parts of the Microsoft Excel window:
  • Quick Access Toolbar: commands of your choice.
  • Tabs (File, Home, Insert, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View) and the Ribbon: shows the commands of the current tab.
  • Name Box: shows the cell address of the current cell.
  • Formula Bar: shows the editable formula (or value) in the current cell.
  • Column letters identify columns; row numbers identify rows.
  • Current cell, and the list of worksheets at the bottom.
A column letter plus a row number form a unique cell address, e.g. the cell in column B, row 4 is B4.
cards.zh:
Excel 视窗主要部分：快速存取工具列、索引标签 (tabs) 与功能区 (ribbon)（显示当前标签的指令）、名称方块 (Name Box)：显示当前储存格位址、资料编辑列 (Formula Bar)：显示可编辑的公式、栏字母 (column letters)、列号 (row numbers)、工作表清单。
栏字母 + 列号 = 唯一的储存格位址 (cell address)，例如 B 栏第 4 列是 B4。注意：英文 column 是直的“栏”，row 是横的“列”。

ex.q: The cell in the 3rd column and the 10th row is selected. What does the Name Box show? Where can you see its formula?
ex.a: Column 3 = C, row 10, so the Name Box shows C10. The formula is shown in the Formula Bar.
ex.az: 第3栏是C，名称方块显示 C10；公式在资料编辑列看到。

cards.tz: 输入数据与删除储存格
cards.en:
To input or change data in a cell you can:
  • click the cell and type (this replaces the original data);
  • double-click the cell to place the text cursor in it, then edit;
  • select the cell and click the formula bar, then edit.
Finish input by selecting another cell or pressing Enter/Tab; press Esc to undo the input.
Delete key only clears the content of a cell; the cell stays. To remove a cell completely, right-click → Delete... and choose Shift cells left / Shift cells up / Entire row / Entire column, so other cells move to take its position.
cards.zh:
输入或修改：单击后直接输入（会取代原有内容）；双击储存格进入编辑；或选取后在资料编辑列编辑。按 Enter/Tab 或点其他储存格完成，按 Esc 取消。
按 Delete 键只是清除内容，储存格仍在；要整个删除储存格，右键 → 删除，选择右侧储存格左移 / 下方储存格上移 / 整列 / 整栏，其他储存格会补上位置。

ex.q: A3 contains 'Carman' in a class list A1:A6. You want the names below to move up so no blank row remains. What should you do?
ex.a: Select A3 → right-click → Delete... → choose Shift cells up → OK. (Pressing Delete would only clear the content and leave a blank cell.)
ex.az: 用右键「删除…」选「下方储存格上移」，不是按 Delete 键。

cards.en:
Data in a cell can be stored in different number formats and therefore displayed in different ways. The default is General. Others: Number, Currency, Accounting, Short Date, Long Date, Time, Percentage, Fraction, Scientific, Text.
Example of 6.875: General 6.875, Number 6.88, Currency $6.88, Percentage 687.50%, Fraction 6 7/8, Scientific 6.88E+00.
Change it: right-click → Format Cells, or Home tab → Number group drop-down. You can also increase/decrease decimal places and add a thousands separator.
Key point: the number format only determines how data is shown. Changing the number format has no impact on the cell value. Dropped digits are still stored (3.14159265 shown as 3.14 can be shown as 3.1416 again).
Misconception: number format can be applied to cells containing any type of data, including text, not only numbers.
cards.zh:
同一数据可以用不同数值格式 (number format)显示，预设是通用格式 (General)；其他有数值、货币、会计、简短/详细日期、时间、百分比、分数、科学记号、文字。
例：6.875 → 数值 6.88、货币 $6.88、百分比 687.50%、分数 6 7/8、科学 6.88E+00。
可增减小数位、加千分位。
重点：格式只影响显示，不改变储存格的值 (no impact on the cell value)；隐藏的小数仍保存。
误解：格式只能用于数字 ✗；其实任何类型数据（包括文字）都可套用。

ex.q: A1 contains 3.14159265 formatted to 2 decimal places (shows 3.14). What is the result of =A1*2?
ex.a: The stored value is still 3.14159265, so =A1*2 gives 6.2831853, not 6.28 exactly from 3.14×2.
ex.az: 格式不改值，用原值 3.14159265 计算。

cards.t: Text format and wrong automatic formats
cards.tz: 文字格式与自动判断错误
cards.en:
After input, Excel automatically determines the number format, e.g. typing 2020/12/31 changes the format to Date. This is sometimes wrong:
  • Typing 5E01 (class 5E, number 01) becomes Scientific and shows 5.00E+01.
  • Typing a product ID 001.100 shows 1.1: leading and trailing zeros are lost.
Solution: change the number format of the cell to Text before inputting the data, so data is shown exactly as typed. Text format also prevents a value starting with = from being treated as a formula.
Exam use: IDs, phone numbers, bib numbers with leading zeros should be stored in Text format.
cards.zh:
输入后 Excel 会自动判断格式，有时会错：输入 5E01 变成科学记号 5.00E+01；输入 001.100 显示 1.1，前置零不见了。
解决：输入前先把格式改成「文字」(Text)，就会照打的显示；文字格式也能防止以 = 开头的内容被当成公式。
考试：有前置零的编号（学生编号、号码布 001）要用 Text format。

ex.q: Runners have bib numbers 001 to 500. Which format keeps all bib numbers 3-digit? Explain.
ex.a: Text format. Only text keeps the leading zeros; Number/Accounting/Scientific would convert 001 to 1.
ex.az: 只有文字格式保留前置零。

cards.en:
Wrap Text: when text is wider than its cell, it overflows into the next cell if that cell is blank. Wrap Text splits the text into multiple lines within the cell. Press Alt+Enter to insert a manual line break. If the row has a fixed height, wrapped text may not be fully shown.
Merge & Center: merges multiple adjacent cells into one and centres the data (alignment can be changed later). Only the data in the top-left cell is kept; the rest is lost. In Excel you can unmerge a merged cell but you cannot split an ordinary cell (unlike table cells in Word).
Recognise in exam: a missing border line between two cells means they are merged.
cards.zh:
自动换列 (Wrap Text)：文字太长时，若右边储存格是空的会溢出显示；开启后会在同一储存格内分成多行。Alt+Enter 手动换行。若列高固定，可能显示不全。
跨栏置中 (Merge & Center)：把相邻储存格合并并置中，只保留左上角储存格的数据，其余会丢失。Excel 可以取消合并，但不能分割一个普通储存格（与 Word 表格不同）。
考试辨认：两格之间的框线消失 → 合并了。

ex.q: A1 contains '1st term' and B1 contains 'x'. You select A1:B1 and click Merge & Center. What does the merged cell show?
ex.a: Only the top-left cell's data is kept: it shows 1st term centred; 'x' is lost.
ex.az: 只保留左上角 A1 的数据。

cards.en:
Move the cursor to the border line after the column/row, then click and drag. Double-click the border line to auto-adjust (AutoFit).
If a number/date value is wider than its column, instead of overflowing it may display ####. The value is still correctly stored; just widen the column. (Text overflows, numbers show #### or are rounded.)
Error values in Excel start with #, e.g. #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, #NAME?, #REF!, #NULL!.
cards.zh:
把游标移到该栏/列之后的框线拖动即可；双击框线自动调整。
数值或日期比栏宽时不会溢出，可能显示 ####，但值仍正确储存，只要加宽栏位。
Excel 错误值都以 # 开头：#VALUE!、#DIV/0!、#NAME?、#REF!、#NULL!。

ex.q: A date in C2 shows ########. Is the data lost? How to fix?
ex.a: No. The value is stored correctly; the column is too narrow. Widen column C (drag or double-click the border to AutoFit).
ex.az: 数据没有丢失，加宽栏位即可。

cards.en:
Format as Table (Home tab): select the range, click Format as Table, pick a style, confirm 'My table has headers'. Enhances readability; header drop-down buttons are for filtering and sorting.
Freeze Panes (View tab): keeps rows/columns (e.g. table headers) always visible when scrolling through many records. Options: Freeze Top Row, Freeze First Column, or Freeze Panes based on the current selection (freezes rows above and columns left of the selected cell).
Choose what to freeze by what the reader needs to keep seeing: scrolling down → freeze the header row; scrolling right → freeze the identifying column (e.g. User ID).
cards.zh:
格式化为表格：套用表格样式，提高可读性；标题的下拉按钮用于筛选和排序。
冻结窗格 (Freeze Panes)（检视标签）：卷动时让某些列/栏一直可见，例如标题列。选项：冻结首列、冻结首栏，或按目前选取的储存格冻结（冻结其上方的列和左边的栏）。
判断：向下卷要看标题 → 冻结第一列；向右卷要看 ID → 冻结第一栏。

ex.q: A sheet has User ID in column A and 30 columns of data. When scrolling right, the manager can't see the User ID. What should be frozen?
ex.a: Freeze the first column (column A); freezing the first row as well is optional. Select B2 and Freeze Panes to freeze both.
ex.az: 冻结第一栏；同时冻结首列亦可（选 B2 再冻结窗格）。

cards.t: AutoFill: Copy Cells vs Fill Series
cards.tz: 自动填满：复制储存格 vs 以数列填满
cards.en:
AutoFill fills adjacent cells automatically: drag the fill handle (bottom-right corner) or double-click it.
  • Copy Cells: copies the selected cell(s) to the other cells. Selecting several cells (4A,4B,4C,4D) repeats them.
  • Fill Series: fills based on the pattern of the selected cells. It recognises arithmetic sequences only (common difference); other sequences (e.g. geometric 2,4,8) give abnormal results.
Defaults: a single cell with numbers only → Copy Cells; text followed by a number (e.g. A1 → A2, A3...) → Fill Series. Hold Ctrl while dragging to switch the default; or use the AutoFill Options button (Copy Cells, Fill Series, Fill Formatting Only, Fill Without Formatting, Flash Fill). Always double-check the result.
cards.zh:
自动填满 (AutoFill)：拖动储存格右下角的填满控点，或双击它。
复制储存格 (Copy Cells)：把内容重复复制；以数列填满 (Fill Series)：按选取储存格的规律填，只识别等差数列，等比等会出怪结果。
预设：只有数字的单一储存格 → 复制；文字后带数字（如 A1）→ 数列（A2、A3…）。拖动时按 Ctrl 可切换，或用「自动填满选项」按钮。记得检查结果。

ex.q: A1=12, A2=16 are selected and filled down to A6 with Fill Series. What are A3:A6?
ex.a: Common difference 4: 20, 24, 28, 32.

ex.q: A1 contains 'Room1' and is dragged down 3 cells. What appears by default?
ex.a: Text followed by a number → Fill Series by default: Room2, Room3, Room4.
ex.az: 文字+数字预设为数列填满。

cards.en:
An Excel file is a workbook, not a spreadsheet. A workbook can contain multiple worksheets (sheets), each storing a related set of data. E.g. workbook Form 4.xlsx contains worksheets Class 4A, Class 4B, Class 4C.
Hierarchy: Workbook → Worksheet → Row/Column → Cell.
Click a sheet tab to change the current worksheet; click + to add a sheet; right-click a tab to rename / copy it.
cards.zh:
Excel 档案是活页簿 (workbook)，可以包含多个工作表 (worksheet/sheet)。例如 Form 4.xlsx 内有 Class 4A、4B、4C 三个工作表。
层次：活页簿 → 工作表 → 列/栏 → 储存格。
点工作表标签切换、按 + 新增、右键可重新命名或复制。

ex.q: A school keeps one file for all S5 classes with one sheet per class. Name the file-level object and the sheet-level object.
ex.a: The file is a workbook; each class sheet is a worksheet.
ex.az: 档案=活页簿；每班=工作表。

cards.en:
A formula is an expression that evaluates automatically. It often uses data from other cells, and its result is refreshed when related data is changed. Excel treats cell content as a formula when the first character is =.
Elements of a formula: constants, operators, cell references, functions. E.g. =(SUM(B2:E2)+10)*$G$1.
Constants (3 types):
  • Number: 314, 1.62E+03 (right-aligned by default)
  • Text string: "3Pies" (left-aligned; in a formula must be enclosed in double quotation marks)
  • Boolean: TRUE / FALSE (centre-aligned), used by logical functions
cards.zh:
公式 (formula) 是会自动计算的式子，常引用其他储存格，相关数据改变时结果自动更新。储存格第一个字元是 = 才会被当成公式。
组成部分：常数、运算符、储存格参照、函数，例：=(SUM(B2:E2)+10)*$G$1。
常数三种：数字（预设靠右）、文字字串（靠左；在公式中要用双引号括住）、布林值 TRUE/FALSE（置中）。

ex.q: G2 contains =AVERAGE(D2:F2) and shows 82.0 with D2=64, E2=90, F2=92. D2 is changed to 84. What happens?
ex.a: G2 is a formula, so it updates automatically: (84+90+92)/3 = 88.7.
ex.az: 公式自动更新为 88.7。

cards.t: Arithmetic operators and order of operations
cards.tz: 算术运算符与运算次序
cards.en:
Arithmetic operators: + (plus), - (minus), * (times), / (divided by); enrichment: % (percent) and ^ (to the power of).
Order of operations:
  1. Exponentiation ^
  2. Multiplication and division * /
  3. Addition and subtraction + -
Use parentheses () to prioritise. Misconception: for nested brackets use () in every layer; [] and {} have other meanings in Excel and are invalid here: =(((A1+B1)*C1)-D1)/E1 not =([(A1+B1)*C1]-D1}/E1.
Arithmetic works on numbers in scientific notation too. Examples: =6*11.5+7*2 → 83; =6*(11.5-7)*2 → 54; =20+30% → 20.3; =7^2*2+1 → 99.

ex.az: 逐步计算得 27。

ex.q: Evaluate =2+3*2^2.
ex.az: 先次方再乘再加，得 14。

cards.en:
Comparison operators compare values and return a Boolean (TRUE/FALSE): = (equal to), <> (not equal to), <, >, <=, >=.
They can compare numbers, text strings and Booleans. Text comparison is case insensitive: ="iLoVeYoU"="ILOVEYOU" → TRUE; ="Cat"="cat" → TRUE. For case-sensitive comparison use EXACT().
Examples: =3*5=15 → TRUE; =15<>5*3 → FALSE; ="12"<>"6*2" → TRUE ("6*2" is just text); =0.2<=0.2 → TRUE; =-1>=-2 → TRUE.
cards.zh:
比较运算符回传布林值：= 、<>（不等于）、< 、> 、<= 、>=。
可比较数字、文字、布林值；文字比较不分大小写：="Cat"="cat" 为 TRUE。要分大小写用 EXACT()。
例：=15<>5*3 → FALSE；="12"<>"6*2" → TRUE（"6*2" 只是文字，不会计算）。

ex.q: Evaluate ="ABC"="abc" and =EXACT("ABC","abc").
ex.a: = is case insensitive → TRUE; EXACT is case sensitive → FALSE.
ex.az: = 不分大小写，EXACT 分。

cards.en:
The only text concatenation operator is &. It joins two values into one text string; non-text values are converted to text first.
="con"&"cat" → concat; =10&TRUE → 10TRUE.
Very common use: building criteria strings, e.g. ">="&B9 in COUNTIF/SUMIF, or joining names =A2&" "&B2. CONCATENATE() does the same job.
#VALUE! occurs when a variable in a formula is wrong, e.g. arithmetic on text that cannot be converted to a number: =2+"3" → 5, but =2+"3c" → #VALUE!.
cards.zh:
唯一的文字连接运算符是 &，把两个值接成一个文字字串，非文字会先转成文字：=10&TRUE → 10TRUE。
常用：在 COUNTIF/SUMIF 中组成条件 ">="&B9；或 =A2&" "&B2 接姓名。CONCATENATE() 作用相同。
#VALUE!：参数类型错，例如 =2+"3c"（无法转成数字）。但 =2+"3" 会得 5。

ex.q: A2='Chan', B2='Tai Man'. Write a formula giving 'Chan Tai Man'.
ex.a: =A2&" "&B2 (or =CONCATENATE(A2," ",B2)).
ex.az: 中间要加一个空格字串。

cards.t: Cell references in formulae and errors
cards.tz: 公式中的储存格参照及错误
cards.en:
Cell references identify a cell or range by cell address, e.g. =A1, =B1/(A1+C1).
With A1=12, B1=25, C1=18: =B1-C1>A1 → 7>12 → FALSE; =B1/(A1+C1) → 0.8333.
Errors (enrichment):
  • #NULL!: an operator is missing between references, e.g. =A1 B1.
  • #DIV/0!: dividing by 0, e.g. =16/(2*4-8), or =D1/D2 when D2 is 0 (or empty).
  • #NAME?: non-existing / misspelled function name, e.g. =LAGRE(...).
  • #REF!: reference out of range or referenced cell deleted.
  • #VALUE!: wrong type of argument.
cards.zh:
储存格参照用位址指向储存格或范围。A1=12、B1=25、C1=18：=B1-C1>A1 → FALSE。
错误：#NULL!（参照之间漏了运算符，如 =A1 B1）、#DIV/0!（除以 0）、#NAME?（函数名拼错）、#REF!（参照超出范围或被删除）、#VALUE!（类型错误）。

ex.q: Name the error for each: (a) =SUMM(A1:A3) (b) =A1/(B1-B1) (c) =A1 A2
ex.a: (a) #NAME? (b) #DIV/0! (c) #NULL!
ex.az: 函数名错、除以零、漏运算符。

cards.en:
A reference to a cell in another worksheet or workbook is an external cell reference. Format:
'file path[workbook]worksheet'!cell address
Example: 'C:\Users\Public\Desktop\[wb1.xlsx]ws2'!A1 refers to A1 of worksheet ws2 in workbook wb1.xlsx. The file path can be omitted when the workbook is open. Within the same workbook: =Shop1!B2 or ='Buyer list'!B2 (quotes needed if the sheet name has a space). Reference operators can be used, e.g. =SUM(Shop1!B2:B4).
cards.zh: 指向其他工作表或活页簿的储存格叫外部储存格参照。格式：'路径[活页簿]工作表'!位址。活页簿已开启时可省略路径。同一活页簿内：=Shop1!B2；工作表名有空格要加单引号：='Buyer list'!B2。也可配合范围：=SUM(Shop1!B2:B4)。

ex.q: Sheets Shop1 and Shop2 store profits for June–August in B2:B4. Write a formula in Summary!B3 for the total profit of both shops.
ex.a: =SUM(Shop1!B2:B4)+SUM(Shop2!B2:B4) (or =SUM(Shop1!B2:B4,Shop2!B2:B4)).
ex.az: 两个工作表各自加总再相加。

cards.tz: 参照运算符：范围(:) 与联集(,)
cards.en:
Reference operators create a range of cells for calculations, mainly in functions.
  • Range operator : creates a reference containing all cells between two references inclusively, e.g. B2:C3 = B2,B3,C2,C3. Whole columns/rows allowed: B:C, 1:3.
  • Union operator , combines references into one, e.g. =SUM(A1,B2,C3).
With A1:C3 = 12 25 18 / 14 26 21 / 16 27 24: =SUM(A1:C2) → 116; =SUM(B:C) → 141; =SUM(A1,B2,C3) → 62.
cards.zh: 参照运算符：范围运算符 : 包含两个参照之间（含两端）的所有储存格，例 B2:C3 = B2,B3,C2,C3，也可整栏 B:C；联集运算符 , 把多个参照合并，例 =SUM(A1,B2,C3)。

ex.az: 逐个相加得 87。

ex.q: Same data. How many cells does A2:C3 contain, and what is =SUM(A2:C3)?

cards.en:
Functions are predefined formulae that perform calculations. Many need one or more arguments inside parentheses, separated by commas. E.g. LARGE(array, k) returns the k-th largest value in array: =LARGE(A2:C3,3).
Function names are case insensitive (=large(...) works). A misspelled or non-existing function gives #NAME?. Functions can be nested (one function as argument of another), e.g. =UPPER(MID(E10,FIND(" ",E10)+1,3)).
cards.zh: 函数是预先定义好的公式，括号内放参数 (arguments)，用逗号分隔。例 LARGE(array,k) 回传第 k 大的值。函数名不分大小写；拼错得 #NAME?；函数可以嵌套使用。

ex.a: Sorted descending: 27,26,25,24,21,18,... 5th largest = 21.
ex.az: 由大到小第五个是 21。

cards.t: Mathematical functions: SUM, ABS, INT, RAND, SQRT
cards.en:
Core mathematical functions:
  • SUM(number1, number2, ...): sum of all arguments (constants or ranges), e.g. =SUM(99,88,B7).
  • ABS(number): absolute value (removes the negative sign): =ABS(-2.5) → 2.5.
  • INT(number): rounds down to the nearest integer; negative numbers are rounded away from 0: =INT(8.9) → 8, =INT(-2.5) → -3.
  • RAND(): random number ≥0 and <1, evenly distributed; takes no arguments.
  • SQRT(number): square root: =SQRT(16) → 4.
Random integer from a to b: =INT(RAND()*(b-a+1))+a, e.g. 0 to 5: =INT(RAND()*6). Note =INT(RAND()*5) never gives 5 because RAND() < 1.
cards.zh:
SUM 加总所有参数；ABS 绝对值；INT 向下取整，负数会远离 0：INT(-2.5) = -3；RAND() 回传 ≥0 且 <1 的随机数，没有参数；SQRT 平方根。
产生 a 到 b 的随机整数：=INT(RAND()*(b-a+1))+a；0–5 用 =INT(RAND()*6)。=INT(RAND()*5) 永远不会得 5。

ex.q: Write a formula for a random integer from 1 to 6 (a dice).
ex.a: =INT(RAND()*6)+1: RAND()*6 is in [0,6), INT gives 0–5, +1 gives 1–6. (Also =RANDBETWEEN(1,6).)
ex.az: RAND()*6 取整后 +1。

ex.q: Write a formula for the hypotenuse when the two shorter sides are in A2 and B2.
ex.a: =SQRT(A2*A2+B2*B2) (or =SQRT(A2^2+B2^2)). Note: × is not an operator; use *.
ex.az: 乘号要用 *。

cards.en:
SUMIF(range, criteria, sum_range): returns the sum of cells in sum_range whose corresponding cells in range match criteria.
criteria is a text string containing a comparison operator followed by a value; "=" can be omitted. To use a cell value in the criteria, join with &: ">"&B9. range and sum_range must correspond (same size/position). If sum_range is omitted, range itself is summed.
Data used:
ABCD
1ClassNumberNameScore
21B4Ben-2.5
31A15Ada7.45
41A16Amy8.9
51B22Benedict4.75
61A24Cole5.3
71C34Carmen5.3
=SUMIF(A2:A7,"1A",D2:D7) → 7.45+8.9+5.3 = 21.65; =SUMIF(B2:B7,">20",D2:D7) → 4.75+5.3+5.3 = 15.35.
Common mistakes: ≥ is not valid (use >=); swapping range and sum_range; ranges that do not correspond.
Enrichment: SUMIFS() sums with multiple criteria.
cards.zh:
SUMIF(range, criteria, sum_range)：当 range 中对应储存格符合 criteria 时，把 sum_range 的值加总。
criteria 是文字字串：比较运算符+值，= 可省略；要用储存格值就用 & 连接：">"&B9。range 和 sum_range 要对应。
例：=SUMIF(A2:A7,"1A",D2:D7) = 21.65。常见错误：用 ≥、两个范围倒转、范围不对应。多条件用 SUMIFS。

ex.q: Age in column D, balance in column E (rows 2–1001). Write a formula for the total balance of clients aged 30 or above.
ex.a: =SUMIF(D:D,">="&30,E:E) or =SUMIF(D2:D1001,">=30",E2:E1001).
ex.az: 条件范围是年龄 D，加总范围是余额 E。

cards.en:
• ROUND(number, num_digits): rounds to num_digits decimal places (half away from 0): =ROUND(7.45,1) → 7.5; =ROUND(-2.5,0) → -3.
  • ROUNDDOWN(number, num_digits): rounds toward 0 (unlike INT): =ROUNDDOWN(-2.5,0) → -2; =ROUNDDOWN(4.75,1) → 4.7.
  • ROUNDUP(number, num_digits): rounds away from 0: =ROUNDUP(5.3,0) → 6; =ROUNDUP(-2.5,0) → -3.
  • RANDBETWEEN(bottom, top): random integer between bottom and top inclusive.
  • POWER(number, power): same as ^: =POWER(2,10) → 1024; =POWER(343,1/3) → 7.
Compare: INT(-2.5) = -3 but ROUNDDOWN(-2.5,0) = -2.
cards.zh: ROUND 四舍五入（.5 远离 0）；ROUNDDOWN 趋向 0：ROUNDDOWN(-2.5,0) = -2（与 INT 不同，INT 得 -3）；ROUNDUP 远离 0：ROUNDUP(5.3,0)=6；RANDBETWEEN(bottom,top) 包含两端的随机整数；POWER 与 ^ 相同。

ex.q: Find =INT(-7.2), =ROUNDDOWN(-7.2,0), =ROUNDUP(-7.2,0), =ROUND(-7.25,1).
ex.a: INT → -8; ROUNDDOWN (toward 0) → -7; ROUNDUP (away from 0) → -8; ROUND → -7.3.
ex.az: INT 向下，ROUNDDOWN 向 0，ROUNDUP 远离 0。

cards.en:
Logical functions create conditional formulae, usually with comparison operators. They return Booleans.
  • AND(logical1, logical2, ...): TRUE only if all arguments are TRUE.
  • OR(logical1, logical2, ...): TRUE if any argument is TRUE.
  • NOT(logical): reverses TRUE/FALSE.
Misconception: OR() is inclusive or, so =OR(TRUE,TRUE) → TRUE (not exclusive or like 'coffee or tea').
Range conditions need AND: 'age between 12 and 18 inclusive' → AND(C2>=12,C2<=18). De Morgan: NOT(OR(x<7,y<2)) = AND(x>=7,y>=2).
cards.zh:
逻辑函数用来写条件公式，回传布林值。AND：全部 TRUE 才 TRUE；OR：任一 TRUE 即 TRUE；NOT：反转。
误解：OR 是包含性或 (inclusive or)，=OR(TRUE,TRUE) 是 TRUE。
“介乎 12 至 18（包括）”要用 AND(C2>=12,C2<=18)。德摩根定律：NOT(OR(x<7,y<2)) 等于 AND(x>=7,y>=2)。

ex.q: An award is given if X score (C10) is at least 7 OR Y score (D10) is at least 2. Write the formula for E10 (TRUE/FALSE).
ex.a: =OR(C10>=7,D10>=2). Equivalent: =NOT(AND(C10<7,D10<2)).
ex.az: 至少 = >=；任一符合用 OR。

cards.en:
IF(logical_test, value_if_true, value_if_false): if logical_test is TRUE returns value_if_true, else value_if_false. Text results must be in double quotes.
Examples: =IF(D3>D2,"Ada Won","Ada not won"); =IF(OR(D2<B9,D5<B9),"fail","pass").
Nested IF for several grades: test in order, from one end:
=IF(H2<60,"F",IF(H2<75,"C",IF(H2<90,"B","A")))
Watch boundaries: 'pass if ≥5' → =IF(C10<5,"Fail","Pass") or =IF(C10>=5,"Pass","Fail"); =IF(C10>5,...) wrongly fails a score of 5.
IF can also protect against special cases, e.g. =IF(H10="N/A","N/A",RANK(H10,H:H)).
cards.zh:
IF(条件, 真时值, 假时值)。文字结果要加双引号。
嵌套 IF 处理多个等级，按顺序由一端测试：=IF(H2<60,"F",IF(H2<75,"C",IF(H2<90,"B","A")))。
小心边界：“≥5 合格” 用 C10<5 判 Fail，或 C10>=5 判 Pass；用 >5 会令 5 分不合格。
IF 亦可处理特殊情况，如 "N/A"。

ex.q: Grade: score ≥ 80 → 'Distinction', ≥ 50 → 'Pass', otherwise 'Fail'. Score in B2. Write C2.
ex.a: =IF(B2>=80,"Distinction",IF(B2>=50,"Pass","Fail")). Check 80 → Distinction, 50 → Pass, 49 → Fail.
ex.az: 由高到低测试，注意 >=。

cards.t: Text functions (1): CHAR, TEXT, VALUE, CONCATENATE, LEN
cards.en:
• CHAR(number): character from the computer's character set: CHAR(65) → A, CHAR(66) → B, CHAR(97) → a.
  • TEXT(value, format_text): converts value to text in a format. Codes: 0 digit always shown (even if zero, keeps leading zeros), # digit shown only if needed, , thousands separator, . decimal point, / fraction, E+0 scientific, - hyphen, "abc" literal text, date codes dd/mm/yy. =TEXT(15,"0000") → 0015; =TEXT(1234567,"#,##0") → 1,234,567; =TEXT(42,"0000.00") → 0042.00; =TEXT(3.141593,"#.###") → 3.142.
  • VALUE(text): converts text to a number (error if not a number). Excel often converts automatically.
  • CONCATENATE(text1, text2, ...): joins strings, same as &.
  • LEN(text): number of characters: LEN("Benedict") → 8; LEN(9) → 1.
cards.zh: CHAR 按字元码回传字元（65→A，97→a）；TEXT 按格式把值转成文字：0 一定显示（可保留前置零）、# 需要时才显示、, 千分位、. 小数点，例 TEXT(15,"0000")=0015；VALUE 文字转数字；CONCATENATE 与 & 相同；LEN 字元数。

ex.q: User ID in C2 is 100023. Player ID = last 4 digits + 1, always 4 digits with leading zeros. Write D2.
ex.az: 取后4位、加1、用 TEXT "0000" 补零。

cards.t: Text functions (2): LEFT, MID, RIGHT, case, TRIM, FIND
cards.en:
• LEFT(text, num_chars): from the start: LEFT("Benedict",3) → Ben.
  • MID(text, start_num, num_chars): from position start_num: MID("Benedict",3,5) → nedic.
  • RIGHT(text, num_chars): from the end: RIGHT("Benedict",4) → dict.
  • LOWER / UPPER / PROPER(text): lowercase / uppercase / first letter of each word uppercase: PROPER("benedICT") → Benedict.
  • TRIM(text): removes all spaces except single spaces between words.
  • FIND(find_text, within_text, start_num): starting position of find_text; case sensitive; start_num may be omitted if 1: FIND("a","Amanda") → 3; FIND("a","Amanda",4) → 6; FIND("ver","universe") → 4.
Typical pattern: text after a space: MID(E10,FIND(" ",E10)+1,3); text before a space: LEFT(A2,FIND(" ",A2)-1).
cards.zh:
LEFT/MID/RIGHT 取左、中、右的字元；LOWER/UPPER/PROPER 转小写、大写、首字母大写；TRIM 去多余空格；FIND 找出子字串开始位置，分大小写，FIND("a","Amanda")=3（大写 A 不算）。
常用：空格后的字 MID(E10,FIND(" ",E10)+1,3)；空格前的字 LEFT(A2,FIND(" ",A2)-1)。

ex.q: E10 = '12 December'. Write a formula giving 'DEC'.
ex.a:
Space is at FIND(" ",E10) = 3, month starts at 4.
=UPPER(MID(E10,FIND(" ",E10)+1,3))
ex.az: 找空格位置 +1，取3字，再转大写。

ex.q: A2 = 'David_Archer'. Write a formula for initials 'D.A.'.
ex.a: =LEFT(A2,1)&"."&MID(A2,FIND("_",A2)+1,1)&"."
ex.az: 取第一字母及底线后一字母，各加句点。

cards.t: Additional text functions: EXACT, CODE, REPLACE, SEARCH, SUBSTITUTE
cards.en:
• EXACT(text1, text2): TRUE if exactly the same; case sensitive (unlike =): EXACT("Apple","apple") → FALSE.
  • CODE(text): code of the first character: CODE("A") → 65; CHAR(CODE("APple")) → A.
  • REPLACE(old_text, start_num, num_chars, new_text): removes num_chars characters from start_num then inserts new_text: REPLACE("Benchmark",2,3,"irt") → Birthmark; REPLACE("Benchmark",2,4,"ook") → Bookmark.
  • SEARCH(): same as FIND but case insensitive: SEARCH("a","Amanda") → 1.
  • SUBSTITUTE(text, old_text, new_text, instance_num): replaces old_text by new_text; instance_num chooses which occurrence, else all: SUBSTITUTE("Mindy has a pin.","i","a") → Mandy has a pan.; with instance 2 → Mindy has a pan.
cards.zh: EXACT 完全相同（分大小写）；CODE 第一个字元的字元码；REPLACE 按位置取代；SEARCH 与 FIND 同但不分大小写；SUBSTITUTE 按内容取代，可指定第几次出现。

ex.q: Find =REPLACE("Benchmark",1,5,"Land") and =SUBSTITUTE("banana","a","o",3).
ex.a: REPLACE removes 'Bench' (5 chars) and inserts 'Land' → Landmark. SUBSTITUTE changes only the 3rd 'a' → banano.
ex.az: REPLACE 按位置；SUBSTITUTE 只换第3个 a。

cards.t: Information functions: ISBLANK, ISNUMBER, ISTEXT, ISEVEN, ISODD
cards.en:
Information functions identify the data of a cell.
  • ISBLANK(value): TRUE if the referenced cell is empty.
  • ISNUMBER(value), ISTEXT(value): TRUE if value is a number / text string. A date is stored as a number, so ISTEXT(date) → FALSE.
  • ISEVEN(value), ISODD(value): test even/odd; they truncate decimal places first: ISODD(7.45) → TRUE.
Note: an empty cell is treated as 0 in calculations, so use ISBLANK (not C10=0) to detect 'not yet entered'.
Example: score 0–3 maps to grade D–A; blank → "N/A": =IF(ISBLANK(C10),"N/A",CHAR(68-C10)) (68 is D; score 3 → CHAR(65) = A).
cards.zh:
资讯函数判断储存格资料：ISBLANK（是否空白）、ISNUMBER、ISTEXT（日期是数字，ISTEXT 得 FALSE）、ISEVEN/ISODD（会先截去小数）。
空白储存格在计算中当 0，所以判断“未输入”要用 ISBLANK，不要用 =0。
例：=IF(ISBLANK(C10),"N/A",CHAR(68-C10))。

ex.q: Explain why =IF(C10=0,"N/A",...) is wrong when a score of 0 is valid.
ex.a: A blank cell is treated as 0, but a real score of 0 is also 0, so a student who scored 0 would wrongly get "N/A". Use ISBLANK(C10).
ex.az: 0 分和空白都等于 0，要用 ISBLANK 区分。

cards.t: Statistical functions: AVERAGE, COUNT family, MAX, MIN
cards.tz: 统计函数：平均、计数、最大最小
cards.en:
• AVERAGE(number1, ...): mean.
  • COUNT(value1, ...): counts numbers only (text with non-numeric characters is not counted).
  • COUNTA(value1, ...): counts non-empty cells.
  • COUNTBLANK(range): counts empty cells.
  • COUNTIF(range, criteria): counts cells matching criteria (same criteria rule as SUMIF): =COUNTIF(D2:D7,">="&B9).
  • MAX / MIN(number1, ...): largest / smallest number; ignore logical values and text.
Data used:
ABCD
1ClassNumberNameScore
21B4Ben-2.5
31A15Ada7.45
41A16Amy8.9
51B22Benedict4.75
61A24Cole5.3
71C34Carmen5.3
=AVERAGE(D2:D7) → 4.87; =COUNT(A2:A7) → 0; =COUNT(B2:B7) → 6; =MAX(C2:D7) → 8.9; =COUNTIF(D2:D7,">5") → 4.
cards.zh:
AVERAGE 平均；COUNT 只数数字；COUNTA 数非空白；COUNTBLANK 数空白；COUNTIF(range,criteria) 数符合条件的储存格；MAX/MIN 最大/最小（忽略文字和布林值）。
例：COUNT(A2:A7)=0（班别是文字），COUNTIF(D2:D7,">5")=4。

ex.q: Sex is in column C ('m' or 'f'). Write a formula to count male students. Then count students who passed (score in B2:B101 ≥ value in F5).
ex.a:
=COUNTIF(C:C,"m")
=COUNTIF(B2:B101,">="&F5)
ex.az: 条件是文字就直接写；引用储存格要用 &。

cards.en:
RANK.EQ(number, ref, order) (written RANK() in older Excel): rank of number in ref. order 0 or omitted → descending (largest = 1); non-zero → ascending. Ties share the top rank.
RANK.AVG(): ties get the average rank.
Others: MEDIAN() (middle value; =MEDIAN(11,12,13,14) → 12.5), MODE.SNGL()/MODE() (most frequent), LARGE(array,k), SMALL(array,k).
Scores -2.5, 7.45, 8.9, 4.75, 5.3, 5.3: RANK(5.3,D2:D7) → 3; RANK.AVG(5.3,D2:D7) → 3.5; LARGE(D2:D7,2) → 7.45; SMALL(D2:D7,2) → 4.75; MEDIAN → 5.3.
Order of arguments: number first, then ref. Use $ on ref when copying: =RANK(H2,$H$2:$H$1001).
cards.zh:
RANK.EQ / RANK(number, ref, order)：order 为 0 或省略 → 由大到小（最大第1）；非0 → 由小到大。同分取较高名次；RANK.AVG 同分取平均名次。
另有 MEDIAN、MODE.SNGL、LARGE、SMALL。
注意参数次序：先 number 后 ref；复制时 ref 要用绝对参照。

ex.q: Scores 80, 95, 80, 70. Find RANK.EQ(80,...), RANK.AVG(80,...) and RANK(70,...,1).
ex.a: Descending: 95 (1), 80, 80 (2,3), 70 (4). RANK.EQ → 2; RANK.AVG → 2.5; ascending rank of 70 → 1.
ex.az: 同分 EQ 取 2，AVG 取 2.5。

cards.en:
VLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, col_index_num, range_lookup): looks for lookup_value in the leftmost column of table_array, then returns the value in the same row from column number col_index_num (counted within the table).
  • range_lookup TRUE or omitted: approximate (closest) match, list must be sorted ascending; returns the largest value ≤ lookup_value. Ideal for grade tables (lower bounds 0, 60, 75, 90 → F, C, B, A).
  • range_lookup FALSE: exact match, e.g. =VLOOKUP("Ada",C:D,2,FALSE).
HLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, row_index_num, range_lookup): the same but searches the top row and returns from a row.
When copying, make table_array absolute: =VLOOKUP(F2,$I$2:$J$5,2).
cards.zh:
VLOOKUP(查找值, 表格范围, 栏号, 范围查找)：在表格最左栏找查找值，回传同一列第 n 栏的值。
第4参数 TRUE 或省略 → 近似配对（第一栏须由小到大排序，取 ≤ 查找值的最大者，适合等级表）；FALSE → 完全配对。
HLOOKUP 在最顶列找，回传第 n 列。复制公式时表格范围要用绝对参照。

ex.q: K2:L5 holds 0 F / 60 C / 75 B / 90 A. Average in H2 = 76.25. Find =VLOOKUP(H2,$K$2:$L$5,2) and write a version showing "N/A" if H2 is "N/A".
ex.a:
Approximate match: largest lower bound ≤ 76.25 is 75 → B.
=IF(H2="N/A","N/A",VLOOKUP(H2,$K$2:$L$5,2))
ex.az: 近似配对找 ≤76.25 的最大值 75，得 B。

cards.en:
There are 3 types of cell reference: relative, absolute, mixed. They behave the same inside a formula but change differently when the cell is copied (copy/paste or AutoFill).
Relative cell reference (default, e.g. B2:E2): when copied, it changes according to the position of the target cell relative to the original cell. Copying F2 (=AVERAGE(B2:E2)) to F4 (2 rows down) gives =AVERAGE(B4:E4). Copying one column right shifts column letters by 1.
This saves effort: each row automatically uses its own data.
#REF!: if a shifted reference goes out of range (e.g. above row 1 or left of column A), or the referenced cell is deleted.
cards.zh:
储存格参照有三种：相对、绝对、混合；公式内作用一样，复制时变化不同。
相对参照（预设，如 B2:E2）：复制时按目标储存格与原储存格的相对位置移动。F2 =AVERAGE(B2:E2) 复制到 F4（下移2列）→ =AVERAGE(B4:E4)。
好处：每列自动用自己的数据。
#REF!：参照移出工作表范围或被删除。

ex.q: C3 contains =A2+B1. It is copied to E5. What is the formula in E5?
ex.a: Move +2 columns, +2 rows: A2 → C4, B1 → D3. E5 = =C4+D3.
ex.az: 向右2栏、向下2列，每个参照同样移动。

ex.q: B2 contains =A1. It is copied to A2. Result?
ex.a: Move -1 column: A1 → column before A does not exist → #REF!.
ex.az: 超出范围得 #REF!。

cards.en:
Add $ before both the column letter and the row number, e.g. $I$2:$J$5. An absolute cell reference remains unchanged when copied.
Use it for cells whose address never changes: a lookup table, a benchmark/tax rate/exchange rate in one cell, the ref of RANK.
Example: G2 =VLOOKUP(F2,$I$2:$J$5,2) copied to G4 → =VLOOKUP(F4,$I$2:$J$5,2): F2 (relative) moves, the table stays.
Tip: press F4 to cycle between relative, absolute and mixed references.
cards.zh:
在栏字母和列号前都加 $，如 $I$2:$J$5；复制时不变。
用于位置固定的储存格：查找表、基准分、税率、汇率、RANK 的 ref。
例：G2 =VLOOKUP(F2,$I$2:$J$5,2) 复制到 G4 → F4 变，表格不变。按 F4 键切换参照类型。

ex.q: Exchange rate is in E1. B2:B100 hold prices in USD. Write C2 so it can be filled down to C100 to give HKD prices.
ex.a: =B2*$E$1. B2 is relative (changes to B3, B4...), $E$1 stays fixed. Without $, C3 would use E2 (empty → 0).
ex.az: 汇率储存格要用绝对参照。

cards.en:
A mixed cell reference contains only one $: only the column letter or the row number stays unchanged when copied.
  • $B2: column fixed, row changes.
  • B$1: row fixed, column changes.
Used for 2-D tables. Discount table: original price in column B, discounts '10% off', '30% off' in row 1. C2: =$B2*(1-LEFT(C$1,3)). Copied to D3 → =$B3*(1-LEFT(D$1,3)).
Multiplication table: multiplicands in column A, multipliers in row 1 → B2: =$A2*B$1, then fill the whole table.
Rule: put $ in front of the part (column or row) where the referenced data always stays.
cards.zh:
混合参照只有一个 $：$B2 栏固定、列会变；B$1 列固定、栏会变。
用于二维表：原价在 B 栏、折扣在第1列 → C2 =$B2*(1-LEFT(C$1,3))。乘数表：B2 =$A2*B$1。
口诀：数据一直在哪一栏/列，就在那一部分前加 $。

ex.q: B2 contains =$A2*B$1 and is copied to E4. Formula in E4?
ex.a: $A stays, row 2 → 4: $A4; B → E, $1 stays: E$1. E4 = =$A4*E$1.
ex.az: 有 $ 的部分不变，其余随位置移动。

cards.en:
Filtering hides rows of records temporarily and leaves only the records matching the criteria. Data is not deleted.
Steps: select the table → Home/Data → Sort & Filter → Filter → click the drop-down button in a header → untick values (e.g. untick FALSE in 'Failed?').
Number Filters: Equals, Does Not Equal, Greater Than, Less Than, Between... e.g. Average is less than 60, so no extra 'Failed?' column is needed. Can combine two conditions with And / Or.
Text Filters: Equals, Begins With, Ends With, Contains... (e.g. Electives contains 'ICT'). Wildcards: ? = any single character, * = any series of characters.
Clear: drop-down → Clear Filter From "...".
cards.zh:
筛选 (filtering) 暂时隐藏不符合条件的记录，只显示符合的，数据不会被删除。
步骤：选表格 → 排序与筛选 → 筛选 → 按标题下拉按钮。
数字筛选：小于、大于、介于… 可用 And/Or 结合两个条件；文字筛选：等于、开头是、结尾是、包含；万用字元 ? 一个字元、* 任意多个字元。
清除：「清除 … 的筛选」。

ex.q: Show only students whose Electives contain ICT and whose Average is at least 70. How?
ex.a: Turn on Filter. Electives drop-down → Text Filters → Contains 'ICT'. Average drop-down → Number Filters → Greater Than Or Equal To 70. Filters on different columns combine with AND.
ex.az: 两栏各自设筛选，会同时生效。

cards.en:
Sorting arranges the data in an order specified by the users: ascending (Smallest to Largest, A to Z) or descending.
Single criterion: header drop-down → Sort Largest to Smallest (e.g. to get an overview of ranking by Average).
Multiple criteria: Sort & Filter → Custom Sort... → Sort by Average (Largest to Smallest) → Add Level → Then by Chinese (Largest to Smallest). The 2nd level only decides the order of records that tie on the 1st level.
Sort & Filter → Clear removes all sorting and filtering criteria, but clearing sorting does not restore the original order. (Tip: keep an ID column to sort back.)
Filtering and sorting can be combined: filter first, then sort what remains.
cards.zh:
排序按使用者指定次序排列：递增或递减。
单一准则：标题下拉 → 由大到小。
多重准则：自订排序 → 依 Average 由大到小 → 新增层级 → 次依 Chinese 由大到小。第二层只在第一层相同时才起作用。
「清除」移除所有排序筛选准则，但不会还原原本次序（保留编号栏可排回）。

ex.q: Contestants X/Y/Z: David 46/24/x, Diana 67/96/x, Duncan 57/77/x, Deborah 22/.., Dominic 70/25/x. Filter out X < 50, then sort by Y descending. Who is first?
ex.a: Remaining (X ≥ 50): Diana (Y 96), Duncan (77), Dominic (25). Highest Y → Diana.
ex.az: 先筛走 X<50，再按 Y 由大到小，Diana 最高。

cards.en:
Human brains process graphical data faster than textual data, so we visualise data with charts: select the data → Insert tab → choose a chart type (or Recommended Charts).
Elements to name in exams: Chart Title, Chart Area, Plot Area, Data Series, Data Label, Legend, Gridlines, X-Axis, Y-Axis, X-Axis Title, Y-Axis Title. Click an element to change it; use Add Chart Element to add/remove (Axes, Axis Titles, Chart Title, Data Labels, Data Table, Error Bars, Gridlines, Legend, Trendline...).
Different data series must use different colours and a legend so they are not mixed up.
cards.zh:
人脑处理图像比文字快，所以用图表呈现数据：选数据 → 插入标签 → 选图表类型。
要会说的元素：图表标题、图表区、绘图区、数列、资料标签、图例、格线、X/Y 轴及轴标题。用「新增图表项目」加减元素。多个数列要用不同颜色和图例。

ex.q: A student creates a column chart of Chinese and English scores but the reader cannot tell which colour is which subject. Which TWO chart properties should be set?
ex.a: Add a legend (and ensure different colours per data series); add a chart title/axis titles to explain the data.
ex.az: 加图例，再加标题/轴标题。

cards.t: Column, clustered, stacked and bar charts
cards.tz: 直条图、群组及堆叠直条图、横条图
cards.en:
Column chart: data shown as rectangles whose heights are proportional to the values. Effective when the x-axis categories are categorical or discrete (e.g. students, classrooms).
Clustered column chart: several data series side by side in each category: easy to compare different series (Chinese vs English for each student).
Stacked column chart: series stacked: better to compare the sum of all series within a category (total marks).
A column chart is also called a bar chart, but in Excel a bar chart has horizontal bars and a column chart vertical columns.
Data types: categorical (finite groups, no logical order: countries, brands), discrete (countable values: number of students), continuous (infinitely many values between two values: height, temperature, time).
cards.zh:
直条图：长方形高度与数值成正比，适合 x 轴为类别或离散数据。群组直条图：比较不同数列；堆叠直条图：比较每类别的总和。Excel 中横条图 (bar) 是横向的。
数据类型：类别（国家、品牌）、离散（可数：人数）、连续（身高、温度、时间）。

ex.q: A teacher wants to compare each student's TOTAL of Chinese + English + Maths, while still seeing each subject's part. Which chart?
ex.a: Stacked column chart: the column height shows the total; each colour shows one subject.
ex.az: 堆叠直条图显示总和及组成。

cards.en:
Line chart: data shown with lines whose heights are proportional to the values; effective when the categories are continuous (time, years). Lines show the trend. Can be clustered with several series.
Test (Activity 4.1): if the mid-point between two categories has a meaning (temperature at 08:30 between 08:00 and 09:00), use a line chart. If not (between Class 1A and Class 1B), never use a line chart; use a column chart.
Pie chart: a circle/annulus divided into sectors whose central angles are proportional to the values; for categorical/discrete categories. A column chart focuses on the value of each series; a pie chart focuses on the percentage (proportion of the whole).
cards.zh:
折线图：适合连续类别（时间），显示趋势。判断法：两个类别之间的中点有意义（08:30 的温度）才用折线图；没有意义（1A 班与 1B 班之间）就不要用，改用直条图。
圆形图：扇形圆心角与数值成正比；直条图着重数值，圆形图着重百分比/比例。

ex.q: Choose a chart: (a) hourly temperature of a classroom; (b) percentage of students in each elective; (c) heights of 3 students.
ex.a: (a) Line chart (continuous time, trend). (b) Pie chart (percentage of whole). (c) Column/bar chart (each student is a category; heights do not form parts of a whole, so not a pie).
ex.az: 时间→折线；比例→圆形；各人比较→直条。

cards.tz: 假设分析：分析蓝本管理员
cards.en:
What-if analysis is a set of tools that return a list of results based on one or more certain values input by the users, helping make better decisions faster.
Scenario Manager builds multiple scenarios with different values in certain (changing) cells and shows how other values change. Steps: Data → What-If Analysis → Scenario Manager → Add → scenario name (e.g. $10), changing cells (B1), value (10) → OK → Show.
Summary... → choose result cells (B3) → generates a Scenario Summary table (one column per scenario), which can then be charted.
Example: price in B1, number of buyers B2 =COUNTIF('Buyer list'!$B:$B,">="&B1), income B3 =B1*B2; scenarios $10, $20, ... $320 show income 5000, 8580, 14040, 21200, 20320, 640 → $80 gives most income.
Advantage: compare many combinations (e.g. 4 materials × 3 sizes = 12 scenarios) without drastically altering the structure of the data.
cards.zh:
假设分析 (what-if analysis)：按使用者输入的值回传一系列结果，帮助更快作出决定。
分析蓝本管理员 (Scenario Manager)：为变数储存格设定多组不同值（多个情境），看结果如何变。步骤：资料 → 假设分析 → 分析蓝本管理员 → 新增 → 名称、变数储存格、值 → 显示。按摘要选结果储存格可生成分析蓝本摘要表，再画图。
好处：比较多种组合而不需大改资料结构。

ex.q: A shop has 4 materials and 3 sizes for a statue and wants the profit rate of each combination. Which tool, and how many scenarios?
ex.a: Scenario Manager: changing cells = material and size cells; 4 × 3 = 12 scenarios; result cells = profit rate cells; then generate a Scenario Summary and chart it.
ex.az: 用分析蓝本管理员，12 个情境，再做摘要。

cards.en:
Goal Seek lets us set a desired output value for a cell (the goal) and a cell as a variable input; it then seeks a suitable value for the variable cell so the goal cell reaches that value (working backwards).
Steps: Data → What-If Analysis → Goal Seek → Set cell: B3 (must contain a formula) → To value: 23000 → By changing cell: B1 → OK. Result: price 102.68 gives income 23000.
Compare: Scenario Manager = you supply several inputs, see outputs; Goal Seek = you supply one target output, Excel finds one input.
cards.zh:
目标搜寻 (Goal Seek)：设定目标储存格（须含公式）要达到的值，并指定一个变数储存格，Excel 反推出变数应是多少。
步骤：资料 → 假设分析 → 目标搜寻 → 目标储存格 B3、目标值 23000、变数储存格 B1。
比较：分析蓝本是给多个输入看结果；目标搜寻是给一个目标结果求一个输入。

ex.q: G6 =SUMIF(D:D,">"&G5) gives the total of scores above the benchmark in G5. The organiser wants G6 to be 10000. Which tool and what settings?
ex.a: Goal Seek: Set cell G6, To value 10000, By changing cell G5.
ex.az: 用目标搜寻，目标 G6=10000，改变 G5。

cards.en:
A pivot table calculates and summarises a large and complex data set to extract useful information, without rebuilding the table with SUMIF()/SUMIFS().
Steps: select the whole table → Insert → PivotTable → New Worksheet → OK → drag fields into 4 areas: FILTERS, COLUMNS, ROWS, VALUES. Changes update immediately.
Default summarising method of VALUES is Sum; change via Value Field Settings to Count, Average, Max, Min, Product...
Example: Columns = Fruit, Rows = Managed by then Sold by, Values = Sum of Total Profit → which team made the most profit. Average sales volume per fruit per location: Rows = Location, Columns = Fruit, Values = Sales Volume (Average).
Pivot table vs what-if: a pivot table summarises/compares existing data; what-if analysis estimates results under different input values.
cards.zh:
枢纽分析表 (pivot table) 把大量数据计算和摘要，不用自己用 SUMIF/SUMIFS 重建。
步骤：选整个表 → 插入 → 枢纽分析表 → 把栏位拖到筛选、栏、列、值四个区域。值预设是加总，可在「值栏位设定」改为计数、平均值、最大、最小等。
与假设分析分别：枢纽表摘要现有数据；假设分析估算不同输入下的结果。

ex.q: Records: ID, Name, Donation (one row per donation). Produce a table with each Name and the total donation. State the pivot table settings.
ex.a: Set Name as the rows; set Donation as the values with the Sum function.
ex.az: 姓名放列，捐款放值并用加总。

cards.en:
A pivot table can be used to create a pivot chart: select the pivot table → Insert → PivotChart → choose a suitable chart type → OK. Like a pivot table, its fields can be changed anytime and the chart updates.
Choose the type with the same rules as normal charts: categories like locations/stores/fruits → (stacked/clustered) column chart; continuous categories such as time periods → line chart; proportions of one total → pie chart.
cards.zh: 可由枢纽分析表建立枢纽分析图 (pivot chart)：插入 → 枢纽分析图 → 选图表类型。栏位可随时更改，图表即时更新。选类型的原则与一般图表相同。

ex.q: A pivot table shows average sales for time slots 08:00-11:00, 12:00-14:00, 18:00-20:00 (rows) by district (columns). Which pivot chart type is preferred and why?
ex.a: A column chart (clustered): the time slots are separate sessions and districts are categories, so values are compared category by category; a pie chart only shows proportions of one total.
ex.az: 比较各类别数值用直条图。

mc.q: Which of the following is NOT a typical feature of spreadsheet software?
o: Compiling source code into machine code
mc.e: Compiling code is done by a compiler, not a spreadsheet.
mc.ez: 编译程式不是试算表功能。

mc.q: Which of the following is spreadsheet software?
mc.e: Google Sheets, Excel and LibreOffice Calc are spreadsheets.

mc.q: Which part of the Excel window shows the cell address of the current cell?
mc.e: The Name Box shows the current cell address.

mc.q: The cell in the 4th column and 12th row has address:
mc.e: Column 4 = D, row 12 → D12.

mc.q: Cell A1 contains 3.14159265 and is formatted to show 2 decimal places. What is the value of =A1*100?
mc.e: Number format does not change the stored value.

mc.q: Which statement about number format is correct?
o: It can only be applied to cells containing numbers
Changing it changes the cell value
It only determines how the data is shown
Decreasing decimal places deletes the dropped digits
mc.e: Number format affects display only and can be applied to any data.

mc.q: A user types 007 in a General cell and it shows 7. What should be done so that it shows 007?
o: Change the cell to Text format before typing
mc.e: Text format keeps leading zeros.

mc.q: Typing 5E01 into a General cell displays:
mc.e: Excel treats 5E01 as scientific notation (50).

mc.q: When cells A1:C1 are merged with Merge & Center, which data is kept?
o: Data of all three cells joined
mc.e: Only the top-left cell's data is kept.

mc.q: A date cell shows ######. What is the most likely reason?
mc.e: #### appears when a number/date is wider than its column; the value is still stored.

mc.q: Which feature keeps the header row visible while scrolling down a long table?
mc.e: Freeze Panes / Freeze Top Row.

mc.q: A1=3, A2=7 are selected and filled down to A5 using Fill Series. What is in A5?
mc.e: Arithmetic series with difference 4: 11, 15, 19.

mc.q: A single cell containing the number 30 is dragged down by AutoFill (default). The cells below contain:
mc.e: For a single number cell, the default is Copy Cells.

mc.q: Fill Series recognises which kind of sequence?
mc.e: Only arithmetic sequences.

mc.q: Which statement about workbooks is correct?
o: An Excel file is a worksheet
A workbook can contain several worksheets
A worksheet can contain several workbooks
Each workbook has exactly one sheet
mc.e: An Excel file is a workbook containing worksheets.

mc.q: Name the formatting feature: before, 'Alexander the Great' is in one wide line; after, the text is shown on several lines in the same cell.
mc.e: Text split into lines within a cell = Wrap Text.
mc.ez: 同一格内分行是自动换列。

mc.q: Alex changed a row '$30 $35' into '$30 $35 $40 $45 $50' without typing. Which feature did he use?
mc.e: Dragging the fill handle continues the arithmetic pattern.

mc.q: Which of the following is/are correct? (1) The number format of a cell can be defined after storing data. (2) The text alignment of a cell cannot be changed. (3) Every row must share the same row height.
mc.e: Alignment and row height can both be changed.
mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Chapter Exercise MC Q1 (p.72)

What is the result of =2^3*2+1?

mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Chapter Exercise MC Q4 (p.72)

mc.e: Text comparison with = is case insensitive.

mc.q: What is the result of =10&TRUE?
mc.e: & converts both to text and joins them.

mc.q: Which formula gives #VALUE!?
mc.e: "3c" cannot be converted to a number.

mc.q: Which error appears for =A1 B1?
mc.e: Missing operator between references gives #NULL!.

mc.q: Which error appears for =AVERGE(A1:A5)?
mc.e: Misspelled function name.

mc.q: A1:C2 contain 12 25 18 / 14 26 21. What is =SUM(A1:B2)?
How many cells does the reference B2:D5 contain?
mc.e: 3 columns × 4 rows = 12.

mc.q: Which correctly writes ((A1+B1)×C1−D1)÷E1 in Excel?
mc.e: Use () for every layer, * and /.

mc.q: Which refers to cell A1 of worksheet 'ws2' in an open workbook wb1.xlsx?
mc.e: Format [workbook]worksheet!cell (path omitted when open).
mc.ez: 格式 [活页簿]工作表!位址。

mc.q: Which formula returns a random integer from 0 to 5 inclusive?
mc.e: RAND()*6 is in [0,6); INT gives 0–5.

mc.q: What is =INT(-2.5)?
mc.e: INT rounds down; negatives move away from 0.

mc.q: What is =ROUNDDOWN(-2.5,0)?
mc.e: ROUNDDOWN rounds toward 0.

mc.q: Which formulae return the same result? (1) =INT(ABS(-1.5)) (2) =INT(RAND())+1 (3) =LEN(9)
mc.e: All give 1.
mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Chapter Exercise MC Q2 (p.72)

mc.q: Age in column D, balance in column E (rows 2–1001). Which gives the total balance of clients aged 30 or above?
mc.e: Criteria range D, sum range E; ≥ is invalid.
mc.ez: 条件范围 D，加总 E。

mc.q: Which formula calculates the hypotenuse from A2 and B2?
mc.e: Pythagoras, using * for multiplication.

mc.q: What is =OR(TRUE,TRUE)?
mc.e: OR is inclusive or.

mc.q: Pass if score (C10) ≥ 5. Which formula is correct?
mc.e: Only B passes a score of exactly 5 and fails below 5.

mc.q: A prize needs Result (E10) = "Pass" and age (C10) between 12 and 18 inclusive. Which formula?
mc.e: All conditions needed, inclusive bounds.

mc.q: Award if X (C10) ≥ 7 or Y (D10) ≥ 2. Which can be the formula?
mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Checkpoint 4.3 Q1 (p.33) adapted

mc.q: What is =MID("Benedict",3,5)?
mc.e: Start at 3rd character, take 5.

mc.q: What is =FIND("a","Amanda")?
mc.e: FIND is case sensitive, so the capital A is skipped.

mc.q: What is =SEARCH("a","Amanda")?
mc.e: SEARCH is case insensitive.
0 forces a digit to be shown.

mc.q: What is =REPLACE("Benchmark",2,3,"irt")?
mc.e: Remove 'enc' (chars 2–4) and insert 'irt'.

mc.q: What is =UPPER(LEFT("december",3))&LEN("Dec")?
mc.e: LEFT → dec, UPPER → DEC, & 3.

mc.q: Score 0–3 maps to grade D (0) … A (3); blank shows "N/A". Which formula?
mc.e: 68 is 'D'; higher score → smaller code.

mc.q: What is =ISODD(7.45)?
mc.e: Decimals are truncated: 7 is odd.

mc.q: Range A1:A5 contains 3, "abc", (empty), TRUE, 8. What is =COUNT(A1:A5)?
mc.e: COUNT counts numbers only (3 and 8).

mc.q: Same range (3, "abc", empty, TRUE, 8). What is =COUNTA(A1:A5)?
mc.e: Four non-empty cells.

mc.q: Scores 80, 95, 80, 70 in B1:B4. What is =RANK.AVG(80,B1:B4)?
mc.e: 80s occupy ranks 2 and 3 → average 2.5.

mc.q: Rank (A10) from average (H10) descending, but "N/A" if H10 is "N/A". Which formula?
mc.e: RANK(number, ref) with descending default.

mc.q: Grade table K2:L5 (0 F, 60 C, 75 B, 90 A). Which formula gives the grade of H2?
mc.e: Vertical table, return column 2, approximate match.

mc.q: With the grade table above, what is =VLOOKUP(89.9,$K$2:$L$5,2)?
mc.e: Largest bound ≤ 89.9 is 75 → B.

mc.q: VLOOKUP's 4th argument FALSE means:
mc.e: FALSE = exact match.

mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Chapter Exercise MC Q6 (p.73)

mc.q: C3 contains =A1+B2 and is copied to D5. The formula in D5 is:
mc.e: +1 column, +2 rows.

mc.q: B2 contains =$A2*B$1 and is copied to D4. The formula in D4 is:
mc.e: $A fixed column; $1 fixed row.

mc.q: Jane fills a multiplication table (multiplicands in column A, multipliers in row 1) by copying B2. B2 should be:
mc.e: Fix column A and row 1.
mc.ez: 固定 A 栏和第1列。

mc.q: Column C is filled by copying C2 to look up Fruit ID in B2 from table Y2:Z6. C2 should be:
mc.e: Filling down only changes rows, so locking the rows of the table is enough.
mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Checkpoint 4.6 Q1 (p.48) adapted

mc.q: Which key cycles a reference between relative, absolute and mixed?
A1:C3 contain 23 10 5 / 43 13 54 / 11 26 12. Tom enters =SUM(A1:B2) in E1 and copies E1 to F2. What is shown in F2?
Which feature temporarily hides records not matching criteria?
mc.e: Filtering hides rows temporarily.

mc.q: A text filter to show electives containing 'ICT' anywhere should use:
mc.e: Contains matches anywhere in the text.

mc.q: In a text filter, '?' represents:
mc.e: ? = one character, * = any series.

mc.q: Custom sort: by Average (descending), then by Chinese (descending). When does the 2nd level matter?
o: Only when two records have the same Average
mc.e: The 2nd level breaks ties of the 1st.

mc.q: After sorting, the user clicks Sort & Filter → Clear. What happens?
o: Sorting criteria are removed but the order is not restored
Only filters are removed and sorting is undone
mc.e: Clearing does not restore the original order.

mc.q: Which chart is best for showing the percentage of students taking each elective?
mc.e: Pie chart shows proportions of a whole.

mc.q: Which chart best shows the hourly temperature trend of a classroom?
mc.e: Continuous time → line chart.

mc.q: Heights of students 1A01, 1A02, 1A03. Which chart(s) should be used? (1) Bar chart (2) Line chart (3) Pie chart
mc.e: Students are categories (no line); heights are not parts of a whole (no pie).
mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Chapter Exercise MC Q3 (p.72)

mc.q: Which chart best compares each student's total of several subjects?
mc.e: Stacked column shows the sum per category.

mc.q: Which of these is continuous data?
o: Number of students in a class
Travel time from home to school
mc.e: Time can take infinitely many values.

mc.q: The 'before' list has 4 students; the 'after' list shows only Cheung Siu Mei. Which function was used?
mc.e: Rows were hidden → filtering.
mc.src: Textbook A2 Ch4 Chapter Exercise MC Q5 (p.72)

mc.q: Contestants (X,Y,Z): David (46,24,?), Diana (67,96,?), Duncan (57,77,?), Deborah (22,?,?), Dominic (70,25,?). Filter out X < 50, then sort by Y descending. Who is first?
mc.e: Remaining Diana 96, Duncan 77, Dominic 25.

mc.q: A shop owner wants to know which price makes income exactly $23000. Which tool?
mc.e: Goal Seek finds an input for a target output.

mc.q: Which tool compares the results of several sets of input values and produces a summary report?
mc.e: Scenario Manager → Scenario Summary.

mc.q: In Goal Seek, the 'Set cell' must:
o: Contain a formula depending on the changing cell
mc.e: The goal cell is a formula result.

mc.q: Book store: in which should a pivot table be used? (1) Estimate expense by changing number of books bought (2) Estimate profit by changing book prices (3) Compare sales of books of different genres
mc.e: (1),(2) are what-if analysis.

mc.q: Default summarising method of a numeric field in VALUES of a pivot table is:
mc.e: Default is Sum.

mc.q: To show average sales volume of each fruit in each location, the VALUES field Sales Volume should be set to:
mc.e: Use Value Field Settings → Average.

mc.q: Which are the four areas of the PivotTable Fields pane?
mc.e: Filters, Columns, Rows, Values.

parts.q: Complete the formula in F1 to count the students who passed: =COUNTIF( ...

=COUNTIF(B2:B101,"<"&E1) (1)

parts.q: Write a formula for C2 showing "Passed" or "Failed", which can be copied down to C101.

=SUM(Shop1!B2:B4)

Location as columns; Time as rows (1)
