cards.en:
A database is a collection of structured data stored in a computer system that facilitates the storage and retrieval of data. It is designed so that a large amount of data can be stored efficiently. Before databases existed, data were kept manually (e.g. paper files in a filing cabinet), so searching, sorting and filtering were slow and had a higher risk of human error.
Typical uses: online shops and food-delivery apps store each product's name, price, category and description in a database; schools store student records; banks store transactions.
Key exam points: structured (fixed fields), fast retrieval (search / sort / filter), less human error, can be shared by many programs.
cards.zh:
数据库 (database)：a collection of structured data stored in a computer system that facilitates the storage and retrieval of data，即有结构地储存在电脑中的数据集合，方便储存和检索，可以高效储存大量数据。
以前用人手（文件柜）管理数据，搜寻、排序、筛选都慢，而且 human error 风险高。
例子：网购/外卖 app 储存货品名称、价格、类别；学校储存学生资料。考试要点：有结构、检索快、减少人为错误、可供多个程序共用。

ex.q: A small shop records sales in a paper notebook. Give two benefits of switching to a database.
ex.a:
1. Records can be searched, sorted and filtered quickly instead of flipping pages.
2. Fewer human errors, e.g. data are entered in a fixed structure and can be validated (input mask, data type).
(Also acceptable: large amounts of data stored efficiently; data can be shared with other programs.)
ex.az: 1. 可快速搜寻、排序、筛选；2. 数据结构固定并可验证，减少人为错误。

cards.en:
A database management system (DBMS) is software used to create and manage databases. Features listed in the book:
  • creation of new databases;
  • changing the database schema (design);
  • insertion and update of records;
  • retrieval of data through searching;
  • providing an interface for other programs to access the data;
  • creation of forms to facilitate data input;
  • creating reports to present data.
Examples of DBMS: Microsoft Access, MySQL, SQL Server. In Access the window has a Quick Access Toolbar, tabs and a ribbon, a list of Access objects on the left, the workspace, and a list of views at the bottom right. Data are displayed as a table, like a spreadsheet.
cards.zh:
DBMS (database management system) 是建立和管理数据库的软件。功能：建立新数据库、修改 schema（设计）、插入及更新记录、透过搜寻检索数据、提供 interface 让其他程序存取数据、建立 form 方便输入、建立 report。
例子：Microsoft Access、MySQL、SQL Server。Access 界面：Quick Access Toolbar、tabs、ribbon、左边 Access objects 列表、workspace、右下角 views。数据以表格形式显示，像试算表。

ex.q: Which of these is NOT a DBMS: MySQL, Microsoft Excel, SQL Server, Microsoft Access?
ex.a: Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet program, not a DBMS. The other three are DBMS.
ex.az: Excel 是试算表软件，不是 DBMS。

cards.en:
Access objects are the basic elements in an Access file, listed in the left sidebar. The four common types are table, form, report and query. Create them from the “Create” tab.
ObjectPurpose
TableStores and displays data in rows (records) and columns (fields); the data source of the other three
FormUser-friendly interface showing one record at a time for data entry/editing
ReportDisplays and summarises data for printing; can sort, filter, group, total
QueryFilters, sorts, summarises, updates or deletes data, written in SQL
Forms, reports and queries use tables as their data source, so while they are open you may not be allowed to change the table's data or structure.
cards.zh:
Access 文件的基本元素叫 Access objects，四种：table、form、report、query，在 “Create” tab 建立。
• Table：储存及显示数据，是其他三者的 data source。
• Form：友善界面，一次显示一条记录，方便输入。
• Report：为打印而显示及汇总数据，可排序、筛选、分组、加总。
• Query：用 SQL 筛选、排序、汇总、更新或删除数据。
打开 form/report/query 时，可能不能修改来源 table 的数据或结构。

ex.q: A clerk must type in 500 new customer records quickly with few mistakes; the manager wants a printed monthly summary of sales per branch. Which Access object suits each?
ex.a:
Clerk: a form (simple interface, one record at a time, facilitates data entry).
Manager: a report (displays and summarises data, e.g. grouped totals, for printing).
ex.az: 输入用 form；打印汇总用 report。

cards.en:
Tables are the most important Access object. They have two views: datasheet view and design view.
Datasheet view (default) shows data in columns and rows like an Excel worksheet, but: no cell address; each column is a field, each row is a record; field names stay frozen at the top. You cannot type into an arbitrary cell; every entry must follow the table structure.
  • Last column “Click to Add” is not a field: typing there adds a new field.
  • Last row marked * is not a record: typing there adds a new record.
  • “(New)” in a field means its value (e.g. AutoNumber) is generated automatically.
  • Right-click field name → Rename Field.
  • You can delete a whole field (for all records) or a whole record, but not a field of a single record.
  • Text formatting applies to the whole table (unlike Excel, a cell cannot have its own colour).
cards.zh:
Table 最重要，有 datasheet view 和 design view。
Datasheet view（预设）像 Excel，但：没有 cell address；每一栏是 field，每一行是 record；不能随便在任何格输入，必须跟表结构。
• “Click to Add” 不是 field，在那里输入会新增 field。
• 有 * 的最后一行不是 record，输入会新增 record。
• “(New)” 表示值会自动产生（如 AutoNumber）。
• 右键 field name → Rename Field。
• 只能删除整个 field（所有记录）或整条 record，不能只删某记录的某 field。
• 文字格式对整个表生效。

ex.q: A table has fields ID, SNAME, SEX and 3 records. State what happens if you (i) type 'F' in the last row marked *, (ii) type 'Hong Kong' under 'Click to Add'.
ex.a:
(i) A new record is added (ID filled automatically if AutoNumber, SEX = 'F').
(ii) A new field is added to the table (default name Field1), and 'Hong Kong' becomes the value of that field for that record.
ex.az: (i) 新增一条记录；(ii) 新增一个 field。

cards.en:
Design view shows no records; it shows every field and lets you manage the table structure. Switch using the icon at the bottom-right.
Each row is a field; columns are Field Name, Data Type, Description. The Field Properties panel shows more properties of the selected field: Field Size, Format, Decimal Places, Input Mask, Caption, Default Value, Validation Rule, Validation Text, Required, Indexed. A key icon marks the primary key. Text formatting is not available in design view.
Saving/closing: right-click the object tab → Save / Close. A closed object can be renamed by right-clicking it in the list of Access objects.
cards.zh: Design view 不显示记录，只显示所有 field，用来管理表结构。每一行是一个 field，栏是 Field Name、Data Type、Description。下方 Field Properties 面板有 Field Size、Format、Input Mask、Default Value、Validation Rule、Required 等。钥匙图示表示 primary key。此 view 不能设文字格式。关闭的对象可右键改名。

ex.q: Where in Access would you change the data type of PHONE from Number to Short Text, and set its input mask?
ex.a: Open the table in design view; change the Data Type of the PHONE row; select the row and enter the mask in Field Properties → Input Mask.
ex.az: 在 design view 改 Data Type，并在 Field Properties 的 Input Mask 设定。

cards.en:
Forms allow users to manage data in a table using a user-friendly interface which shows one record at a time. Create: select a table → Create tab → Form.
In form view you can change field values of the current record, move between records with the record navigation buttons, and add a new (blank) record. In layout view you edit the form's layout.
Exam point (Example 5.1): the major purpose of a form is to simplify the user interface / facilitate data entry. It does not reduce computation time or save storage, and filtering can be done in a table anyway.
cards.zh:
Form：用友善界面管理表中数据，一次显示一条记录。选 table → Create → Form 建立。
Form view：修改当前记录、用导航按钮转记录、新增空白记录；layout view：改版面。
考点：form 主要目的是简化用户界面、方便输入，不会减少运算时间或节省储存空间；筛选在 table 本身也可做。

ex.q: Example 5.1 type: What is the major purpose of using a form in a DBMS? A. reduce computation time of data entry B. filter data in a single table C. save storage space D. simplify the user interface
ex.a: D. A form facilitates data entry by simplifying the user interface. It has no effect on computation time or storage; tables can filter data too.
ex.az: 答案 D：form 简化界面。

cards.en:
Reports display and summarise data from tables in a customisable way for printing purpose. Create: select a table → Create → Report. Edit in layout view.
Without changing the table's data you can: sort and filter records; group records (Group On a field); remove unwanted fields; change field format; add summarised fields (right-click → Total: Sum, Average, Count Records, Count Values, Max, Min, Standard Deviation, Variance).
Common elements of a report: records in a specific order and summarised information. Field properties (data type etc.) are not shown in a report.
cards.zh:
Report：为打印目的，以可自订方式显示及汇总表中数据。在 layout view 编辑。
不改变表数据下可：排序、筛选、Group On 分组、删去不要的 field、改格式、加入汇总（Sum、Average、Count、Max、Min 等）。
报表常见元素：按特定次序的记录、汇总资料；不会显示 field properties。

ex.q: Which are common elements in a database report? (1) a chart (2) records in a specific order (3) summarised information (4) field properties of records
ex.a: (2) and (3). Reports sort records and add totals/averages; they do not list field properties, and charts are not a standard report element in the book.

cards.en:
Queries filter, sort, summarise, update or delete data in a table. They are written in Structured Query Language (SQL). (The book does not require UPDATE/DELETE statements.)
Steps in Access: Create → Query Design → close the “Show Table” window → switch to SQL view → type the statement → click Run. The result is shown in datasheet view; switch back to SQL view to edit.
SELECT * FROM STUDENT
returns all records with all fields. A query is not stored in any field; it returns data in the form of a table (unlike a spreadsheet formula, stored in a cell, returning one value). A SELECT alone never changes the stored data.
cards.zh:
Query：筛选、排序、汇总、更新或删除表中数据，用 SQL (Structured Query Language) 编写。步骤：Create → Query Design → 关掉 Show Table → 转 SQL view → 输入 → Run，结果以 datasheet view 显示。
SELECT * FROM STUDENT 返回所有记录所有 field。
Query 与公式分别：公式存在储存格、返回一个值；query 不存在任何 field，返回一个表。SELECT 不会改变数据。

ex.q: Lab 5.1: What does SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT GROUP BY SEX do?
ex.a: It counts the number of students of each sex: records are grouped by SEX and COUNT(*) gives the number of records in each group (e.g. one row for F, one for M).
ex.az: 按性别分组，数每组学生人数。

cards.tz: 数据库表结构 vs 试算表
cards.en:
Compared with a spreadsheet table, a database table has a stricter structure:
  • There cannot be empty columns or empty rows.
  • Each record has the same fields.
  • Every field in the same column shares the same properties (data type, size, mask...).
Also: no cell addresses; formatting applies to the whole table; data type is defined before data entry.
cards.zh: 数据库表比试算表结构更严格：不能有空栏或空行；每条记录有相同的 fields；同一栏的 field 有相同属性（数据类型等）。另外没有 cell address，数据类型在输入前已定义。

ex.q: Give two differences between a spreadsheet table and a database table.
ex.a:
1. A spreadsheet allows empty rows/columns; a database table cannot have empty rows or columns.
2. In a spreadsheet each cell can hold any type of data; in a database every value in a field shares the same data type/properties, defined before data entry.
ex.az: 1. 不可有空行空栏；2. 同一 field 数据类型一致。

cards.en:
The data type of a field is defined before data entry; changing it may change the stored values.
TypeExampleRemarks
TextHello World!Different sizes; Short Text stores up to 255 characters
Number3.1416Integers by default; can be set to decimals
Date/Time24/1/2015Stores a number and presents it as a date
Currency$3.14Like number, 4 decimal places by default
AutoNumber1, 2, 3Generates a unique number automatically for each new record
Yes/No☑Boolean; true = -1, false = 0
Choosing rules: IDs with leading zeros (e.g. 034930) must be Text because a number field drops leading zeros; values with two states (registered or not) → Yes/No (smallest storage); money → Currency; dates → Date/Time (allows date comparison and avoids daily updates).
cards.zh:
Field 的 data type 在输入前定义，改变它可能改变储存值。
• Text：Short Text 最多 255 字符。
• Number：预设整数，可改小数。
• Date/Time：储存一个数字，以日期显示。
• Currency：类似 number，预设 4 位小数。
• AutoNumber：每条新记录自动产生唯一编号。
• Yes/No：Boolean，true = -1，false = 0。
选择：有前导零的编号（034930）要用 Text；两种状态用 Yes/No（最省空间）；金额用 Currency；日期用 Date/Time。

ex.q: Choose data types for: SID '034930', DOB, CREDIT ($154.60), REGISTERED (yes/no), PHONE '3287-6957' (8 digits).
ex.a: SID: Text (keep leading zero). DOB: Date/Time. CREDIT: Currency. REGISTERED: Yes/No. PHONE: Number is possible (8 digits, hyphen shown by input mask, less storage) or Text (if it may contain '+', spaces or leading zeros).
ex.az: SID 用 Text；DOB 用 Date/Time；CREDIT 用 Currency；REGISTERED 用 Yes/No；PHONE 可用 Number（省空间）或 Text。

cards.en:
If a field of a record stores no data, it is NULL, and NULL has no data type.
Misconception: “When the field value is 0, it is NULL.” Wrong! 0 is a Number value; NULL means nothing is stored.
Analogy: 124 = there are 124 dollars in the piggy bank; 0 = there is no dollar in the piggy bank; NULL = there is no piggy bank.
Consequences: test with IS NULL / IS NOT NULL, never = NULL; aggregate functions like AVG/SUM/COUNT(field) ignore NULL values (but COUNT(*) counts rows); a primary key can never be NULL.
cards.zh:
Field 没有储存数据就是 NULL，NULL 没有数据类型。
误解：「值是 0 就是 NULL」→ 错！0 是 Number，有数据类型。
比喻：124 = 钱罂有 124 元；0 = 钱罂没有钱；NULL = 根本没有钱罂。
所以要用 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL，不能用 = NULL；AVG、SUM、COUNT(field) 会忽略 NULL；primary key 不能是 NULL。

ex.q: SCORE values: 80, 0, NULL, 70. Find AVG(SCORE), COUNT(SCORE), COUNT(*).
ex.a:
AVG ignores NULL but counts 0: (80+0+70)/3 = 50.
COUNT(SCORE) = 3 (NULL ignored). COUNT(*) = 4 (all rows).
ex.az: AVG = 150/3 = 50；COUNT(SCORE)=3；COUNT(*)=4。

cards.en:
A primary key is a key field that stores unique data for every record, used to identify a record from all the others. Every table should have one. Rules:
  • values must be unique (no duplicates);
  • values cannot be empty (NULL).
Choose a field that should never store duplicated data, not just one that happens to be unique now. E.g. in STUDENT, SID is a good primary key (no two students share a student ID); SNAME is unique in a small sample but two students could have the same name, so it is not suitable.
Set in design view: select field(s) → Design tab → Primary Key; a key icon appears. By default records are sorted by the primary key ascending.
cards.zh:
Primary key：为每条记录储存唯一数据、用来识别每条记录的 key field。规则：不可重复、不可为 NULL。
要选永远不应重复的 field，而不是「现在刚好没重复」的。例：SID 合适；SNAME 现在唯一但将来可能同名，不合适。
Design view 选 field → Design → Primary Key，出现钥匙图示。记录预设按 primary key 升序。

ex.q: Table MONITOR (CLASS, CLASSNO, SID, SNAME), exactly one monitor per class. Which fields can be the primary key?
ex.a: CLASS (one monitor per class, so no duplicates) and SID (unique student ID). CLASSNO and SNAME can repeat.
ex.az: CLASS 和 SID 都可以。

cards.en:
A primary key consisting of more than one field is a composite key.
In STUDENT, neither CLASS nor CNO alone is unique, but CLASS + CNO can be a primary key because no two students share the same class and class number simultaneously.
Other examples: a sports-day PARTICIPANT table where a student can join many events → EventID + StudentID; a TRANSACTION table where one transaction has many items → TransID + ItemID. To set it, select both fields (drag on the grey area on the left) in design view, then click Primary Key.
cards.zh:
由多于一个 field 组成的 primary key 叫 composite key。例：CLASS 或 CNO 单独都会重复，但 CLASS + CNO 不会（同班同学号只有一人）。
其他例子：一名学生可参加多个项目 → EventID + StudentID；一张单有多件货品 → TransID + ItemID。设定：在 design view 拖选两个 field 再按 Primary Key。

ex.q: WAREHOUSE / COMMODITY / QUANTITY / COST: (Tuen Mun, Pen), (Tuen Mun, Pencil), (Yuen Long, Pen), (Tsing Yi, Pencil). Quantities and costs change regularly. Suggest a primary key.
ex.a: WAREHOUSE + COMMODITY. Each warehouse stores each commodity once, so the pair is unique. QUANTITY changes regularly and may duplicate, so it must not be part of the key.
ex.az: WAREHOUSE + COMMODITY；QUANTITY 会变，不适合。

cards.en:
Sometimes no field (or combination) can uniquely identify a record. E.g. TRANSACTION(TDATE, TYPE, AMOUNT): two deposits of 20000 could happen on the same date, so even all fields together may duplicate, and using all fields as a key is meaningless.
Solution: add a new field (e.g. ID) that assigns a unique identity number to each record, and set it as the primary key. If its data type is AutoNumber, the number is assigned automatically.
cards.zh:
有时没有任何 field（或组合）能唯一识别记录，例如 TRANSACTION(TDATE, TYPE, AMOUNT)：同一天可能有两笔相同金额存款，用全部 field 做 key 也无意义。
做法：新增一个 ID field，为每条记录指定唯一编号，设为 primary key；用 AutoNumber 就会自动编号。

ex.q: A programmer stores all chat messages (sender ID, content, sending time). Which field can be the primary key?
ex.a: None of these is guaranteed unique (a sender sends many messages, contents repeat, two messages can share a timestamp). Add a message ID (e.g. AutoNumber) as the primary key.
ex.az: 加 message ID（AutoNumber）做 primary key。

cards.en:
The field size determines how large the storage size of a field is. A text field of field size N can store N characters only. Setting a suitable size helps validate the data (length check) and saves storage space.
E.g. SID always 6 characters → size 6; SEX → 1; CLASS → 2. SNAME should not be set to 3, since some names are longer (e.g. 4-character names, English names).
For number fields (e.g. CNO), field size decides the range of numbers storable (varies between DBMS). A 2-digit non-negative integer in a number field needs fewer bits than 2 characters of text. Some types (e.g. AutoNumber) cannot have a field size set.
Enrichment: 0–99 = 100 values → at least 7 bits (27=128). Two ASCII characters → at least 14 bits (7 bits each).
cards.zh:
Field size 决定 field 的储存大小。text field size N 只能存 N 个字符。设定合适大小可验证数据及节省空间。例：SID 6、SEX 1、CLASS 2；SNAME 不应设 3（有人名字较长）。
Number field 的 size 决定可存的数值范围。2 位非负整数用 number 存比用 2 个字符省空间。AutoNumber 等不能设 size。
延伸：0–99 共 100 个值 → 至少 7 bits；2 个 ASCII 字符 → 至少 14 bits。

ex.q: The maximum quantity of a commodity is 400,000. What is the minimum storage size (in whole bytes) for the field?

cards.en:
An input mask ensures the data is valid by restricting the user input. Use it when data always follow a specific format. Set in Field Properties → Input Mask.
CharMeaning
0must be a digit
9can be a digit
#can be a digit, space, + or -
Lmust be a letter
?can be a letter
Amust be a digit or letter
acan be a digit or letter
&must be a character or space
Ccan be a character or space
. , : ; - /decimal point, thousands separator, date/time separators
>following letters converted to uppercase
<following letters converted to lowercase
\next character shown literally
"…"enclosed characters shown literally
Examples: phone 0000\-0000 (3203-4930); student ID 000000; class 0>L (4A); quantity 999999; month >L<LL (Apr). In a number field the hyphen is displayed only, not stored. Letters typed into a 0 position are ignored; after the last position no more input is accepted.
cards.zh:
Input mask：限制用户输入以确保数据有效，适用于固定格式的数据。
常用：0 必须数字；9 可以数字；# 数字/空格/+/-；L 必须字母；? 可以字母；A 必须字母或数字；a 可以字母或数字；& 必须字符或空格；C 可以字符或空格；> 之后转大写；< 之后转小写；\ 下一字符照显示；双引号内照显示。
例：电话 0000\-0000；学号 000000；班别 0>L；月份 >L<LL。Number field 的连字号只显示、不储存。

ex.q: Write an input mask for a class like '4A' that converts the letter to uppercase, and state what happens if a user types 'a4'.
ex.a: 0>L: first must be a digit, then the following letter is converted to uppercase. Typing 'a' first is ignored (0 needs a digit), so 'a4' cannot be entered as is; typing '4a' gives 4A.
ex.az: 0>L；先打 a 会被忽略，打 4a 会变成 4A。

cards.en:
Format has similar syntax to an input mask, but format only affects how the value of a field is displayed; it has no impact on the actual value stored.
Misconception: “Format determines how a field stores the value.” Wrong: data type determines how a field stores the value; format changes how it is displayed.
Example: default Date/Time format is “General Date”, so 4 January 2015 shows as 4/1/2015, which an American reads as 1 April. Setting the format to yyyy-mm-dd shows 2015-01-04; the stored date is unchanged.
cards.zh:
Format 语法像 input mask，但只影响显示方式，不影响储存值。
误解：「format 决定如何储存」→ 错，data type 决定储存，format 决定显示。
例：4/1/2015 美国人会读成 4 月 1 日；把 format 设为 yyyy-mm-dd 显示 2015-01-04，储存的日期不变。

ex.q: A DOB field shows 25/4/2015. After changing Format to yyyy-mm-dd, what is displayed and does a query WHERE DOB = #2015-04-25# still match?
ex.a: Displayed: 2015-04-25. Yes, it still matches, because the stored value did not change; only its display changed.
ex.az: 显示 2015-04-25；仍然匹配，因储存值没变。

cards.t: Database design: list and name the fields
cards.tz: 数据库设计：列出及命名 fields
cards.en:
Steps for designing a table: list the fields → name the fields → define the fields.
1. List the fields needed, e.g. for student personal information: student ID, Chinese name, English name, sex, class, class number, date of birth, address, email. Find a field with no chance of duplication as the primary key (student ID).
2. Name the fields: names should be simple, meaningful and distinctive, following a consistent naming principle (e.g. CNAME, ENAME or nameZH, nameEN). Avoid:
  • whitespaces, underscores and special symbols (may be incompatible in some DBMS);
  • names of digits only (mixed up with numbers);
  • reserved words such as NAME, DATE, TEXT (any letter case), which have special meanings and may cause errors.
Result: SID, CNAME, ENAME, SEX, CLASS, CNO, DOB, ADDRESS, EMAIL.
cards.zh:
设计表的步骤：列出 fields → 命名 → 定义。
1. 列出需要的 fields，并找不可能重复的 field 做 primary key（学号）。
2. 命名：简单、有意义、易区分，命名规则要一致。避免：空格、底线、特殊符号；纯数字名称；保留字如 NAME、DATE、TEXT（大小写无关），可能引致错误。

ex.q: Criticise these field names: 'Chinese Name', 'Date', '1234', 'eng_name'.
ex.a: 'Chinese Name' contains a space; 'Date' is a reserved word; '1234' is digits only (confused with a number); 'eng_name' has an underscore and is inconsistent with the others. Better: CNAME, DOB, SID, ENAME.
ex.az: 空格、保留字、纯数字、底线且不一致。改为 CNAME、DOB、SID、ENAME。

cards.en:
3. Define the fields: decide the data type, field size, format, input mask and other properties by considering what data will be stored.
FieldTypeSizeFormat / Mask
SIDText6mask 000000
CNAME, ENAME, ADDRESS, EMAILText255
SEXText1
CLASSText2mask 0>L
CNONumber
DOBDate/Timeformat yyyy-mm-dd
Reasons: SID is Text because a number field does not store leading zeros (034930 → 34930). CLASS size 2 validates the length and saves space; an extra space (' 4A') would mess up sorting and filtering. Mask 0>L rejects formats like '4a' (converted) or 'A4'.
cards.zh:
3. 定义 fields：按要储存的数据决定 data type、field size、format、input mask。
理由：SID 用 Text，因为 number 不保留前导零（034930 → 34930）；CLASS size 2 可验证长度、省空间，避免多余空格影响排序筛选；0>L 保证格式正确（数字+大写字母）。

ex.q: Design CLASS for values like 4A, 5D. Give data type, field size and input mask with reasons.
ex.a: Data type Text (contains a letter). Field size 2 (always 2 characters; validates length, saves space). Input mask 0>L (a digit, then a letter forced to uppercase).
ex.az: Text；size 2；mask 0>L。

cards.en:
Phone numbers: if all are 8-digit HK numbers, storing as a Number saves space (one ASCII character needs at least 7 bits, 8 characters ≥ 56 bits, while 99,999,999 fits in 27 bits); the hyphen can be shown by an input mask. Store as Text when numbers may contain '+', country codes, spaces or leading zeros.
Boolean vs text (Example 5.2): REGISTERED stored as Text 'YES'/'NO' can still be controlled by an input mask (uppercase only, ≤3 characters), but a Yes/No field takes less storage space and can only be TRUE/FALSE ('NONE' impossible).
Date vs “days since”: store the registration date rather than the number of days since registration, so data need not be updated every day.
A Boolean field suits only two states; if a third value may appear (e.g. a third gym branch), keep Text.
cards.zh:
电话：全是 8 位数字可用 Number（省空间：8 个字符 ≥56 bits，数字只需 27 bits），连字号用 input mask 显示；有 +852、空格或前导零就要用 Text。
Boolean vs Text（Example 5.2）：Text 'YES'/'NO' 也可用 input mask 限制，但 Yes/No 更省空间，且只能是 TRUE/FALSE。
储存日期而不是「已过天数」：不用每天更新。
Boolean 只适合两种状态；将来可能有第三个值就用 Text。

ex.q: A gym has two branches 'Gym 1' and 'Gym 2'. The manager wants to change GYM to a Boolean. Agree?
ex.a: Partly: Boolean saves space and prevents typing errors since only two values exist. But I disagree: if a new branch opens, a Boolean cannot store a third value, and TRUE/FALSE is not meaningful for a branch name. Keep Text (possibly with validation).
ex.az: 不同意：多开一间分店就无法储存，TRUE/FALSE 意义不清。

cards.en:
Like Excel, filtering shows only records matching criteria. Types: text filter, number filter, date filter.
Steps: click the arrow on a field name → tick/untick values (or Text/Number/Date Filters, e.g. Between… with a date range) → OK. More than one filter can be applied at the same time (combined with AND).
Toggle Filter: clears the filter temporarily; click again to restore. Advanced → Clear All Filters: removes filters permanently. Filtering does not delete any record.
cards.zh:
Filtering（筛选）只显示符合条件的记录，有 text、number、date filter。按 field 名的箭头 → 选值或 Filters（如 Between…）→ OK。可同时套用多个 filter（效果等于 AND）。
Toggle Filter 暂时取消，再按恢复；Advanced → Clear All Filters 永久清除。筛选不会删除记录。

ex.q: Filter SEX = 'M' then a date filter DOB Between 21/6/2015 and 22/7/2015. Write the equivalent SQL.
ex.a:
SELECT * FROM STUDENT
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND DOB BETWEEN #2015-06-21# AND #2015-07-22#
ex.az: 两个 filter 等于 WHERE 中用 AND 连接。

cards.en:
Sorting arranges records in a specific order. By default, records are sorted by the primary key in ascending order. You can sort by multiple criteria: choose a sort order on one field, then on another (Ascending A→Z / Oldest→Newest, Descending Z→A / Newest→Oldest).
Remove Sort clears all sorting criteria and restores the default (primary key ascending). In SQL this is ORDER BY.
cards.zh: Sorting（排序）：预设按 primary key 升序。可用多个准则排序。Remove Sort 清除所有排序，回到预设（primary key 升序）。SQL 用 ORDER BY。

ex.q: After Remove Sort on table STUDENT (primary key SID), in what order are records shown?
ex.a: In ascending order of SID, the primary key (default order).
ex.az: 按 SID 升序。

cards.en:
Basic form: 
SELECT field1, field2 FROM table
SELECT lists the fields/expressions to be shown; FROM gives the table name. * means all fields.
SELECT CLASS, CNO, CNAME FROM STUDENT
SELECT * FROM STUDENT
Columns in the result can be rearranged freely without altering the source table. The result is a table; nothing is stored.
cards.zh: 基本格式 SELECT 字段 FROM 表：SELECT 列出要显示的字段/运算式，FROM 写表名，* 表示所有字段。结果是一个表，不会改变来源表。

ex.q: List the English name and class of all students from STUDENT.
ex.a: SELECT ENAME, CLASS FROM STUDENT
ex.az: SELECT ENAME, CLASS FROM STUDENT

cards.tz: 计算、AS 与算术运算符
cards.en:
Expressions can be calculated in SELECT: 
SELECT *, (SCORE1 + SCORE2) / 2 FROM STUDENT
The expression appears as a column in the result only; it is not added as a field in the table (Access names it Expr1000).
AS renames a column (an alias, optional): 
SELECT CNAME AS Name, (SCORE1 + SCORE2) / 2 AS AverageScore FROM STUDENT
Arithmetic operators: + - * /. Calculation follows the order of operations in Mathematics; use parentheses ( ) to prioritise, never [ ] or { }.
In Access + also concatenates text: SELECT CNAME + ' ' + ENAME FROM STUDENT. Adding a number to text gives an error. (Standard SQL / SQLite uses || for concatenation.)
cards.zh:
SELECT 可计算：(SCORE1 + SCORE2) / 2 只是结果中的一栏，不会新增 field。
AS 给栏改名（alias，可省略）。
算术运算符 + - * /，按数学运算次序，用圆括号（不能用 [ ] { }）。
Access 中 + 也可串接文字：CNAME + ' ' + ENAME；数字加文字会出错。（SQLite 用 || 串接。）

ex.q: SCORE1 = 71, SCORE2 = 78. What does SCORE1 + SCORE2 / 2 give, and what should be written for the average?
ex.a: Division first: 71 + 39 = 110 (wrong). Correct: (SCORE1 + SCORE2) / 2 = 74.5.
ex.az: 先除后加得 110；要用括号得 74.5。

cards.en:
WHERE filters records: 
SELECT CNAME, DOB FROM STUDENT
WHERE SEX = 'M' AND DOB < #2015-04-01#
  • Enclose text in single quotation marks ('M'); most DBMS use single quotes, so always use them.
  • In Access a date is enclosed by hash symbols #2015-04-01#; other DBMS use '2015-04-01'.
  • Numbers have no quotes.
DISTINCT filters out duplicate rows: 
SELECT DISTINCT CLASS FROM STUDENT
lists each class once (avoids redundancy of information).
cards.zh:
WHERE 筛选记录。文字用单引号（'M'）；Access 的日期用 # 包住（#2015-04-01#），其他 DBMS 用单引号；数字不加引号。
DISTINCT 去除重复：SELECT DISTINCT CLASS FROM STUDENT 每班只列一次。

ex.q: List each different class in STUDENT once.
ex.a:
SELECT DISTINCT CLASS FROM STUDENT
Without DISTINCT, every record's class is listed (e.g. '1A' twenty times).
ex.az: 用 DISTINCT。

cards.t: Comparison operators and data type mismatch
cards.tz: 比较运算符与类型不符
cards.en:
Comparison operators: = equal, <> not equal, <, >, <=, >=.
In most DBMS, text comparison is case sensitive and follows dictionary order: 'cat' < 'dog'; 'apple' < 'application'.
Data types must match in a criteria expression, otherwise error (“Data type mismatch in criteria expression”). SID is Text, so write 
SELECT CNAME FROM STUDENT WHERE SID > '035028'
not SID > 035028.
cards.zh:
比较运算符：= <> < > <= >=。多数 DBMS 文字比较区分大小写，按字典次序：'cat' < 'dog'、'apple' < 'application'。
条件中数据类型要相符，否则 “Data type mismatch”。SID 是 Text，要写 SID > '035028'。

ex.q: Is 'Chan' < 'Chau' true? Is 'Ng' < 'Ngai'?
ex.a: 'Chan' vs 'Chau': first difference at 4th letter, 'n' < 'u' → true. 'Ng' is a prefix of 'Ngai' → shorter comes first → true.
ex.az: 两者都是 true（字典次序）。

cards.en:
OperatorMeaning
ANDTRUE only if all conditions are TRUE
ORTRUE if at least one condition is TRUE
NOTTRUE if the following condition is FALSE
Watch out: AGE >= 20 OR AGE <= 25 is true for every age (always true); AGE >= 20 AND AGE <= 25 is the range 20–25. NOT AGE < 25 = AGE >= 25. AND is evaluated before OR, so use parentheses when mixing.
cards.zh:
AND：全部真才真；OR：至少一个真就真；NOT：条件假则真。
注意 AGE >= 20 OR AGE <= 25 对所有年龄都成立；AND 才是 20–25 范围。NOT AGE < 25 即 AGE >= 25。AND 先于 OR，混用时加括号。

ex.q: Ages: 27, 23, 34, 22, 19, 25. How many records for (i) NOT AGE < 25 (ii) AGE >= 20 OR AGE <= 25 (iii) AGE >= 20 AND AGE <= 25?
ex.az: (i) 3 (ii) 6 (iii) 3

cards.en:
IN specifies more than one value in WHERE; values may be text, numbers, dates or Boolean: 
SELECT CNAME, CNO FROM STUDENT WHERE CNO IN (6, 12, 18)
= CNO = 6 OR CNO = 12 OR CNO = 18.
BETWEEN … AND selects values within a range and is inclusive (both ends included): 
SELECT CNAME, DOB FROM STUDENT
WHERE DOB BETWEEN #2015-07-23# AND #2015-08-22#
= DOB >= #2015-07-23# AND DOB <= #2015-08-22#.
cards.zh:
IN 在 WHERE 中指定多个值，等于多个 = 用 OR 连接。
BETWEEN … AND 选范围内的值，包括两端，等于 >= … AND <= …。

ex.q: Rewrite without BETWEEN: SELECT * FROM T WHERE PRICE BETWEEN 10 AND 20. Also: if GENDER only stores 'M' or 'F' (no NULL), which is equivalent to WHERE GENDER IN ('M','F')?
ex.a:
SELECT * FROM T WHERE PRICE >= 10 AND PRICE <= 20
Equivalent: no WHERE at all, or WHERE GENDER = 'M' OR GENDER = 'F'. (GENDER = 'M' AND GENDER = 'F' returns nothing.)
ex.az: BETWEEN 改为 >= AND <=；IN ('M','F') 等于 OR，不是 AND。

cards.en:
LIKE selects text strings that follow a pattern.
MeaningAccessOthers (MySQL, SQLite…)
any number of characters (0 or more)*%
exactly one character?_
WHERE CNAME LIKE '*方*'   -- contains 方
WHERE CNAME LIKE '方*'    -- starts with 方
WHERE CNAME LIKE '??'     -- exactly 2 characters
WHERE ENAME LIKE '%ing'   -- ends with ing (other DBMS)
When interpreting a SQL statement, first recognise which syntax (Access or other) it uses.
cards.zh:
LIKE 选符合模式的文字。通配符：任意数量字符 Access 用 *，其他用 %；恰好一个字符 Access 用 ?，其他用 _。
例：含「方」'*方*'；以「方」开头 '方*'；刚好两字 '??'；以 ing 结尾 '%ing'。先看清是哪种语法。

ex.q: Names: 张耀方, 方嘉慧, 黄忠, 方皇雅. Which match (a) '方*' (b) '*方*' (c) '??'?
ex.a: (a) 方嘉慧, 方皇雅. (b) 张耀方, 方嘉慧, 方皇雅. (c) 黄忠.
ex.az: (a) 以方开头 2 个；(b) 含方 3 个；(c) 两字 黄忠。

cards.t: IS NULL and IS NOT NULL
cards.tz: IS NULL 与 IS NOT NULL
cards.en:
To select NULL or non-NULL values use IS NULL / IS NOT NULL, not a comparison operator like =.
SELECT CNAME, CREDIT FROM STUDENT WHERE CREDIT IS NULL
A primary key field can never be NULL, so WHERE <primary key> IS NOT NULL filters out nothing (Example 5.3).
cards.zh: 选 NULL / 非 NULL 要用 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL，不能用 =。primary key 不能是 NULL，所以 WHERE 主键 IS NOT NULL 不会筛走任何记录（Example 5.3）。

ex.q: CLASS is the primary key of MONITOR. SELECT CLASSNO FROM MONITOR WHERE CLASS IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SCORE returns 3 records. What can you conclude?
ex.a: Since a primary key is never NULL, no record is filtered out, so MONITOR has exactly 3 records. Order is ascending (default). We cannot conclude the table has only 3 fields.
ex.az: MONITOR 刚好 3 条记录；预设升序；不能推断只有 3 个 field。

cards.en:
ORDER BY sorts the result: ASC ascending (default, can be omitted) or DESC descending. Multiple criteria: later ones break ties.
SELECT CNAME, CNO, SCORE1 FROM STUDENT
WHERE CLASS = '1D'
ORDER BY SCORE1 DESC, CNO ASC
Clause order: SELECT … FROM … WHERE … GROUP BY … HAVING … ORDER BY …
cards.zh: ORDER BY 排序：ASC 升序（预设，可省略），DESC 降序。多个准则时后面的用来处理同分。子句次序：SELECT → FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → ORDER BY。

ex.q: MONITOR: (1B,15,10489),(1A,14,10650),(2C,23,08984),(1C,15,10624),(2B,27,09680),(2A,17,09110) as (CLASS,CLASSNO,SID). Output of SELECT SID FROM MONITOR ORDER BY CLASSNO, CLASS?
ex.az: 先按 CLASSNO，再按 CLASS。

cards.tz: 数学函数 INT 与 ABS
cards.en:
INT(number) rounds a number down to the nearest integer; negative numbers are rounded away from 0 (INT(-2.3) = -3). ABS(number) returns the absolute value (removes the negative sign).
SELECT INT(CREDIT) FROM STUDENT   -- $154.60 → $154.00 (currency format kept)
SELECT ABS(-10)                    -- 10
A SELECT clause alone never changes the data: CREDIT is unchanged after the query.

cards.tz: 文字函数 LEN 与 MID
cards.en:
LEN(text) counts the number of characters; a space counts as a character. (Other DBMS: CHAR_LENGTH(), LENGTH().)
MID(text, start_num, num_chars) returns num_chars characters starting at the start_num-th character (counting from 1). (Other DBMS: SUBSTRING() / SUBSTR().)
SELECT ENAME, LEN(ENAME) AS LENGTH FROM STUDENT   -- 'Chan Tai Man' → 12
SELECT CNAME, MID(CNAME, 2, 1) FROM STUDENT        -- 陈大文 → 大
cards.zh: LEN() 计算字符数，空格也算（其他 DBMS：CHAR_LENGTH / LENGTH）。MID(text, start, n) 从第 start 个字符起取 n 个（由 1 开始数）（其他：SUBSTRING / SUBSTR）。

ex.q: CLASS '4A', TEAM 'D-4'. The first character of TEAM should equal the second character of CLASS. Write a condition finding mistyped records.
ex.a:
SELECT * FROM STUDENT WHERE MID(CLASS, 2, 1) <> MID(TEAM, 1, 1)
For 4B / D-4: 'B' ≠ 'D' → selected.
ex.az: 比较 CLASS 第 2 字与 TEAM 第 1 字。

cards.en:
LOWER(text)/UPPER(text) convert to lowercase / uppercase; in Access they are LCASE() and UCASE().
TRIM(text) removes all spaces from the beginning and end (not the middle).
SPACE(number) returns a string of exactly that many spaces.
SELECT LCASE(ENAME), UCASE(ENAME) FROM STUDENT
SELECT TRIM('  When a tree falls  ')   -- 'When a tree falls'
SELECT CNAME + SPACE(10) + ENAME FROM STUDENT
The stored values remain unchanged.
cards.zh: LOWER/UPPER 转小写/大写，Access 写作 LCASE/UCASE。TRIM 去除头尾空格（中间不去）。SPACE(n) 产生 n 个空格。储存值不变。

ex.q: Find LEN(TRIM('  Hi Tom ')).

ex.az: 去头尾空格后 'Hi Tom'，长度 6。

cards.t: GROUP BY with MAX and MIN
cards.en:
Spreadsheets summarise with pivot tables; databases summarise with GROUP BY. Statistical functions can be used without GROUP BY (one result for the whole table), but GROUP BY lets you compare groups.
MAX()/MIN() return the largest/smallest value among the given records.
SELECT CLASS, MAX(SCORE1) AS HIGHEST, MIN(SCORE1) AS LOWEST
FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CLASS
Group by more than one field: GROUP BY CLASS, SEX (one row per class-sex pair). Sort after grouping: ORDER BY MAX(SCORE1) DESC. SELECT MAX(SCORE1) FROM STUDENT returns one value, the highest score of all students.
cards.zh: 数据库用 GROUP BY 汇总（类似 pivot table）。统计函数可不配 GROUP BY（整表一个结果）。MAX/MIN 求最大/最小。可按多个 field 分组：GROUP BY CLASS, SEX；分组后可 ORDER BY MAX(SCORE1) DESC。

ex.q: Write SQL to show each class's highest SCORE1, highest first.
ex.a:
SELECT CLASS, MAX(SCORE1) AS HIGHEST
FROM STUDENT
GROUP BY CLASS
ORDER BY MAX(SCORE1) DESC
ex.az: 按 CLASS 分组，按最高分降序。

cards.en:
COUNT() counts the given records. COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(field) counts non-NULL values.
SELECT CLASS, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CLASS
WHERE filters records before grouping; HAVING filters the summarised groups after grouping:
SELECT CLASS, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM STUDENT
WHERE REGISTERED GROUP BY CLASS

SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT WHERE REGISTERED
GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
REGISTERED is Boolean, so WHERE REGISTERED is enough; = TRUE is redundant.
cards.zh:
COUNT(*) 数行数，COUNT(field) 数非 NULL 值。
WHERE 在分组前筛记录；HAVING 在分组后筛组。REGISTERED 是 Boolean，WHERE REGISTERED 已足够。

ex.q: Show only classes with more than 10 registered students.
ex.a:
SELECT CLASS FROM STUDENT
WHERE REGISTERED
GROUP BY CLASS
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
WHERE keeps registered students; GROUP BY forms classes; HAVING keeps groups with count > 10.
ex.az: WHERE 先筛已注册，HAVING 再筛人数 > 10 的班。

cards.en:
SUM() adds the values of a field; AVG() returns the average (NULLs ignored).
SELECT SEX, SUM(CREDIT) AS TOTAL FROM STUDENT GROUP BY SEX
SELECT SEX, AVG(SCORE1) AS SCORE FROM STUDENT GROUP BY SEX
The alias (AS clause) may be omitted, but with several summarised columns it becomes hard to tell which is which, so aliases help readability.
cards.zh: SUM() 加总，AVG() 平均（忽略 NULL）。AS 别名可省略，但多个汇总栏时用别名较清楚。

ex.q: Table STUDENT (CLASS, CNO, HEIGHT): (1A,10,130), (1A,11,138), (1B,10,142), (1B,11,133), (1C,12,136). Find the output of SELECT CNO, AVG(HEIGHT) FROM STUDENT GROUP BY CNO.

cards.t: Order of evaluation: WHERE → GROUP BY → aggregate
cards.tz: 执行次序：WHERE → GROUP BY → 汇总
cards.en:
To trace a summary query: 1. apply WHERE to each record; 2. group the remaining records; 3. compute the aggregate per group; 4. apply HAVING; 5. ORDER BY.
Example 5.4: FOODMENU, 
SELECT SUM(PRICE) FROM FOODMENU
WHERE NOT (FOODTYPE = 'Side Dish' AND PRICE < 20)
GROUP BY MEALSET
Records matching (Side Dish AND price < 20) are Chicken Nugget (16) and French Fries (14); NOT excludes them. Grouping the rest by MEALSET gives sums 54, 30, 33.
cards.zh: 追踪汇总 query：1. WHERE 逐条筛 → 2. 分组 → 3. 每组计算 → 4. HAVING → 5. ORDER BY。Example 5.4：NOT 排除 Chicken Nugget 和 French Fries，其余按 MEALSET 分组，得 54、30、33。
